tei:div.tei:p: karma pa sku phreng bzhi pa

rol pa'i rdo rje'i lo rgyus/ ༄༅/ /de la dpal mthon mthing gi cod pan 'dzin pa/ karma pa bzhi pa rol pa'i rdo rje ni/ karma pak+shi'i rnam thar bka' rgya ma las/ da ste lo brgya lhag tsam na bram ze chen po'i thugs kyi sprul pa/ dus gsum mkhyen pa'i ngo bo rnam par 'phrul pa zhig byon nas/ bstan pa skyong yang shes dus tshod mar 'grib du song ba'i phyir/ deng sang nga'i phrin las tsam mi 'byung cung zad tsam 'byung*/ zhes gsungs pa dang mthun par sngon pho brang shong tor sku'i bkod pa bsdus zhing zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng nas 'dzam gling la gzigs te/ skad cig gis dga' ldan du lha'i drang srong legs skyes su gyur pa la/ bcom ldan 'das byams pas khyod 'dzam bu'i gling du skyo bar ma byed par/ da dung sems can gyi 'dren pa la song zhig ces lung bstan pa dang de ma thag tu 'dzam bu'i gling du sems can gyi don bya dgos par 'dug snyam pa'i 'dun pa byung ba'i dus su/ bcom ldan byams pa rin po che sna tshogs kyi khri la bzhugs pa'i drung du/ dpal rta mgrin la sogs dpa' bo dang*/ mkha' 'gro'i tshogs du mas dgyes pa'i rnam 'gyur dpag tu med pa mdzad cing*/ sems can gyi don lhun grub tu byung bar gyur cig /ces gsungs nas bdud rtsi drangs shing rab gnas 'thor ba'i snang ba byung ba dang*/ shel gyi khang pa them skas dang bcas pa yod pa la 'ja' tshon sna tshogs 'phro ba/ logs gser gyi sa gzhi lta bu yod pa'i nang du gshegs pa'i snang ba bstan pa dang*/ bde ba can la sogs pa sangs rgyas kyi zhing mtha' dag nas kyang zhing 'dir gshegs pa'i cho 'phrul gyis yum gyi lhums sbyangs te/ sum pa'i yul lho lung chen bco brgyad dang mi ring ba rngod a la rong du/ a la spang dkar zhes bya ba rus chen sdong*/ bye brag ku cor gyi rigs las/ yab lha sdong bsod nams don 'grub dang*/ yum mdza' za brtson 'grus rgyan zhes bya ba gzhan snang du skye bo phal pa dman pa'i tshul bzung ba la/

lcags pho 'brug gi lo zla ba gsum pa'i tshes brgyad kyi nyi shar la sku bltams te/ de ma thag tsog pur bzhugs te ma ṇi dang dbyangs gsal gsungs ba na/ yab the tshom du gyur tshe yum gyis nga la nyi zla khong du chud pa dang*/ phrag gong na nyi zlas brgyan pa dang*/ chu chen la zam pa btsugs pa sogs rmi lam dang*/ skabs 'gar lus rang dbang med par dkrugs shing 'phar ba sogs dngos kyi ngo mtshar mang bas the tshom mi dgos so gsungs/ lte ba bcad pa'i tshe dri bzang po byung ste yul khams khyab/ sngon chos rje rin po che 'da' khar/ slob dpon gu'i gung pa la lung bstan pa bzhin/ dgung lo gsum pa la kong lung ral gsum gyi ya gyal nyang por pheb ma thag yum la nga karma pak+ṣi yin 'dzam gling na gdul bya mang du yod pas 'ong ba yin ltos shig 'chi med 'khrul 'khor bya'o gsungs nas mdzad/ ngas khyod kyi khong du'ang 'di ltar byas pas khyod 'phar ba dang hub phor bo ba sogs byung ba yin/ zho kha brag phyi nags phu rnams su phyin nas blta dgos/ gshin rje dong kha'i 'og na dmyal ba'i zangs kha yod pa nas sems can dpag med 'dren pa yin/ 'di rnams da dung pha la yang ma bshad cig gsungs/ khyed karma pak+ṣi yin na rang byung rdo rje min nam zhes zhus pas de gnyis gcig /nga'i zhal mthong ba la yang ngan song med/ da dung rgyal po'i pho brang gi bar du 'gro/ gdul bya mtha' yas pa 'dul rgyu yod gsung*/ rngo kyog phug tu yum gyi mig la ling thog byung zhing smre ngag bton pas khyod sems pham mi dgos mig zhar dogs med/ khyod ye shes mkha' 'gro brgya rtsa brgyad kyi gcig yin/ khyod gzugs ngan yang bzod de ngas gnas g.yar ba la bzang po ma rnyed pa min/ sang phod da tsam khyod la phyag 'tshal ba mang po 'ong*/ kong bu chu gser gyi lha khang gi rgyab tu sgrub gnas so ma gcig btab nas der 'dug pa yin/ byi ba lo nas kho bo la gdul bya chen po yong ba yin zhes gsungs/

yang dwags lha sgam por 'gro dgos/ nga'i gdan sa bar pa yin/ bka' brgyud kyi pho khrom yang der bzhugs gsungs nas der byon pa'i tshe/ mchod khang rnying mar bka' brgyud pho khrom dang mjal ba'i dus su yab la gsungs pa/ khyod kyis dpa' bo mkha' 'gro 'di rnams kyi zhal mthong ngam zhes pa la/ ma mthong ji lta bu gda' lags zhus pas/ bka' brgyud kyi bla ma rnams la dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dpag tu med pas bskor nas 'dug pa mthong zhes gsungs/ de nas 'ba' nang du byon dus yab kyi chu bran zhig la khur nas 'byon par/ do nub rang re dbyug rdung 'ong sar 'gro ba e yin gsungs pas/ yab kyis khar thal ba thob byas 'dug /de nub zhag sa der 'bri khung pa'i nas 'dren dpon rkya zhig gi mgo byas/ mi sum cu rtsa gcig yod pa la/ drung gis dbyug rdung 'ong zhes pa la brten te/ sngags pa zhig gis mo btab pas dgra mi 'ong zer/ drung gis yab la bos nas rang re snyom chung gi sdod sa 'di tsam yin gsung nas logs shig tu byon nas bzhugs pa dang*/ tho rangs kha khong rnams la dgra byung nas thams cad brdung*/ khal ma dang spyad pa rnams khyer ro/ /nam langs pa dang dpon rkya de na re/ bu chung bden par byung zer nas sha zhig byin no/ /phyir nyin a khus dgra e 'ongs zhus pas mi 'ongs gsungs/ yang dgung lo lnga bzhes pa'i tshe nags phur byon pa'i dus/ chos rje gong ma'i dus mchod byed pa dang 'dzom ste/ drug gi zhal nas khong rnams nga'i mchod pa byed zer nas rang re la ci yang mi ster bar 'dug gsungs/ gzhan dag gis khyed karma pa yin na bla ma kun dga' byams pa da lta gar bzhugs/ 'dir nam 'byon zhes zer ba la/ drug gi zhal nas/ kun dga' byams pa byon rgyu 'dug pa ma mthong*/ rus thum zhig byung 'dug ces gsungs pas/ mi gus pa'i rnam 'gyur mang du byas shing*/ khyad par du khyod rang byung rdo rje yin na 'dis gnod par mi nus kyi zer zhing dom gyi khar 'phangs pa'i tshe/

dom des shin tu dad pa'i rnam 'gyur gyis zhabs la lces ldag par gyur to/ /yang brag gsum mtsho rdzong 'di u rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi sgrub gnas yin zhing*/ gu ru nyid kyis bzhengs pa'i 'bum pa dang*/ zhabs rjes kyang yod pas der 'gro zhag gsum sdod pa yin gsungs nas byon te/ 'khor thams cad la zhabs rjes gsal bar bstan cing*/ ngas kyang byas na 'di 'dra 'ong gsungs mdzad par zhu zhes zhus pas/ da dung dus la ma bab ces gsungs/ yang brag gsum mtsho chur byon dus tsa dkar dar ba zhes bya bas/ khyod grub thob yin na nga'i sgo shes sam zhes zer ba la/ shes gsungs nas gzhan gyis ma bstan par de'i khang pa'i sgo mkhyen te/ nang du byon pas shin tu dad cing bsnyen bkur byas/ rta zhig phul te bsnyen bkur 'bul ba byas pa la kho snga bar 'dug /yang yon bdag zhig gis kyang*/ khyed grub thob yin na bdag gi sgo shes sam zhus pa la/ sngar bzhin mkhyen nas byon pas dad pa thob/ yon bdag btsun pa bya ba zhig na ba la/ sman dpyad rim gro ci byas kyang ma phan nas/ drung gis byin rlabs mdzad de zhag nyi shu rtsa gcig na phan par 'gyur ro/ /zhes lung bstan pas de kho na ltar gyur/ yang brag gsum rngo kyog tu bzhugs pa'i dus/ yab khu khong rang gi yul nas zangs chen zhig len du song ba yun ring po 'gor zhing 'drul pa la dris pas kyang mthong tshor ma byung ste/ gzhan gyis bsad pa yin nam zhes yum dang lcam sring mo gnyis kyis mya ngan byas pa la/ drung gi zhal nas mya ngan mi dgos zhag bzhi na sleb par yod ces gsungs pa la de kho na ltar byung*/ yang tra tir bud med cig nad drag pos btab ste/ smre sngags kyis gsol ba btab cing byin gyi rlobs zhus pas/ khyod mi 'chi zhag bzhi na phan cing bu zhig kyang skye bar 'gyur/ zhes gsungs pas de bzhin du byung*/ yang spang shug thang du byis pa zhig nad kyis gzir ba la byin rlabs mdzad tsam gyis nad las grol te thams cad ngo mtshar du gyur/

de nas rtogs ldan ye rgyal ba dpon slob rnams kyis mjal te/ nags phur 'byon par zhus pa la da lan mi 'gro da bzod khyed pas kyang rta pa mang ba byas nas dar 'phyar dung 'bud cing yong ba yin zhes gsungs/ phyis de kho na ltar gyur/ dgung lo drug bzhes pa'i tshe/ brag phyi lha khang du byon te 'gro mgon gtsug lag khang gi sgo phye gsung nas nang du byon/ chos rje'i sku 'dra la phyag rgya mdzad de phu bo khams bzang ngam gsungs/ gzhan sku gzugs rnams la phyag mdzad cing phyag dang zhe sa'i mchod pa 'bul gsungs/ 'gro mgon la khyod kyi lag na nga'i zhwa dang zhabs rjes yod pa khyer la shog gsungs/ med zhus kyang ma gsan par jo bo'i zhabs rjes yod pa phul bas 'di min nga rang gi de khyer shog gsungs/ de'i tshe lha khang gi rgya mthong la bya rgya bres pa'i steng du byon te ngo mtshar ba'i rdzu 'phrul bstan to/ /der dbu zhwa dang zhabs rjes kyang phul zhing zhabs tog gis mnyes par byas/ de'i sang 'gro mgon la khyod kyis nga shes sam gsungs mi shes lags zhus pas/ dus gsum mkhyen pa yang nga yin/ karma pak+ṣi yang yin/ rgya yul du phyin nas hor dmag btul ba yang nga yin/ da rung 'dul 'phro yod/ sprin gyi mthong nas bstan pa yang nga yin/ nga'i bla ma stong pa nyid yin khyed rnams kyi bla ma nga yin nga la sprul pa gsum yod pa la/ gcig byang chub sems dpa' blo gros rin chen gyi drung na yod/ gcig shar phyogs mngon par dga' ba na yod/ dzam bu'i gling 'dir nga rang 'ongs pa yin/ mi rnams da lta nga la the tshom byed de myur du sol 'gro ba yin/ khyed rnams nga'i 'khor yin/ khyod dge bshes rnams kyang za 'dod kyi che rtsod ma byed par sgrub pa la brtson par gyis shig gsungs/ drung nas de ltar lags na/ rnam thar zhig gsung ba zhu zhus pas/ bar do'i rnam thar gong du smos pa de rnams nyung shas shig gsungs/

yang tshogs gral zhig tu/ nga lo bzhi lon nas pad+ma dkar po sa khar skyes// lo lnga lon nas 'gro la chos bshad byas// lo drug lon nas sems can lam sna drangs// lo bdun lon nas 'gro ba'i gdul bya bskyangs// rin chen nga yi bshad pa yin// de dang mjal na ngan song med// ces gsungs/ yang gzhan zhig gis/ drung yang yang mthong bar dka' zhes bskyar zhing legs par bltas pas/ ltos shig ltos shig nga la ltos// da res mthong ba don ldan yin// dmus long rnams kyi dpal du shar// sangs rgyas bstan pa nub nas shar// gsung yi ge drug ma'i nyi ma shar// zhes gsungs/ yang long po myos kyi dogs rur byon pa'i dus su tshogs pa mang po la chos gsungs te/ de'i nang nas sngags pa dkon mchog skyabs zer ba zhig la gsungs pa khyod kyis lung pa 'di'i mdar zangs zhig gi nang du mar bcug ste nga la phul ba dran nam zhes pa la/ des cung zad bsams te zhus pas khyed la phul ba ma dran/ chos rje rin po che rang byung rdo rje la lung pa 'di'i mda' nyi zla thang du 'bul ba de lta bu zhig byas te de lags sam zhus pas/ de ka yin mod ces gsungs pas dad de zhabs tog phun sum tshogs par byas/ de nas long po bcas sde ru byon pa'i tshe yon bdag mgon po mkhar gyi bu+u gas ra la khyod kyi khyim du 'gro gsungs nas byon te/ khyod kyi sgo 'di sngar 'di phyogs su yod pa la da 'dir bsgyur 'dug ces rgyu mtshan dang bcas te gsungs pas rab tu dad par gyur zhing*/ nga'i pha do nub 'dir phyin nam zhus pas do nub mi phyin 'khyags steng na yod/ sang nub sleb 'ong gsung bas de kho na ltar gyur/ yang khyod kyi sang la gos zhig phul gsungs pa la/ sang phod 'bul ba lags zhus pas sang phod nga la 'bul mi gzhan mang po yong gsungs pas 'phrug phyam bzang po zhig phul/ de nas dgung lo bdun bzhes pa'i tshe lkog 'phreng ba rnams kyis mjal du 'ongs nas lkog 'phreng du 'byon par zhus pa'i tshe/

yab khu gnyis kyis lkog 'phreng du mi 'gro zer ba la/ drung gi zhal nas/ 'gro bas chog rta mang po 'bul mi 'ong bar yod gsungs pas de bzhin du byung*/ de nas se mo gnyan 'khris su sras po lhun grub kyi khang par gdan drangs nas bzhugs pa la sa sros pa na/ drung gi zhal nas/ thog khar 'dong dang phyi rol du bar chad kyi ltas mang po bzlog tu yod gsungs nas khang pa'i steng du byon pa na/ phyi rol gyis phyogs rnams 'dre me kem kem kyis gang 'dug pa la/ drag sngags gsung zhing se gol mdzad pas mod la med par gyur/ 'di'i rgyu mtshan ci lags zhus pas/ sngar lo du ma'i gong du lung pa 'di'i phu brag cig tu/ nga sgrub pa byed cing bsdad pa'i tshe/ mi ma yin 'dul 'phro yod pas/ da res 'dir yang glags lta ba yin 'dug gsungs/ yang byams pa bsam 'grub kyis me tog gangs la nags la mang po phul bas me tog gi 'dab mtsho zhal la baglan te zhal tshom gyi rnam pa ltar mdzad nas/ karma pak+ṣi la 'di 'dra ba yod pa yin gsungs/ yang shākya bsam 'grub la me tog 'ba' zhig gnang nas 'di la nyi zla'i gzugs gyis zhig gsungs/ de ltar byas te phul bas/ zhwa nag po'i mdangs 'dra'am gsungs/ 'dra bar gda' zhus pas/ sras po lhun grub la/ nga'i sngar gyi zhwa de nyi zla'i mdangs yod pa zhig yin pa la/ khyod la yang nga'i zhwa de 'dra ba zhig yod pa khyer la shog gsungs/ zhwa de 'dra nga la med lags zhus pas/ yod khyer shog gsungs nas sngar rang byung zhabs la sras po'i yab kyis rta brgya sogs 'bul chen byas pa'i tshe/ dad rten du gnang ba'i dbu zhwa de phyag tu phul ba'i tshe/ drung gi zhal nas dpal sa ra ha'i dbang zhu yin pas/ thams cad kyis ldang ba gyis phyag 'tshol gsungs/ nangs par nas dbu la bsnams te/ chos rje gong ma'i chos khri'i steng du byon te/ las rgyu 'bras kyi chos mang po gsungs shing thams cad dad pa la bkod 'bul ba mang po byung*/

de nas snyan pa'i ba dan gyis phyogs kun tu khyab ste rta bar rgyal 'dzin gyi sa char nyams dang rtogs pa'i yon tan du ma dang ldan pa bla ma la stod pa rtogs ldan mgon po rgyal mtshan dang mjal ba sogs 'khor gyi thog ma rnams kyang 'dus/ dgung lo dgu bzhes pa'i sa byi lo 'dir tshal pas ja 'dren phul ba sogs mdo dbus kyi mi chen kun gyi ja zhus dang 'bul nod 'byor/ mtshur phu/ karma/ nags phu/ ba yo lkog 'phreng ba sogs gdan 'dren pa mang po kha ma 'chams pas/ chos rje'i zhal nas da res lkog 'phreng du 'gro gsungs nas lkog 'phreng du pheb 'bul nod bsnyen bkur dpag med byas/ chos dung phyag dpe lha rten sogs gong ma'i dus kyi rnams ngos 'dzin mdzad pas thams cad phyag tu phul/ lkog 'phreng gi ri khrod stag khrom du bzhugs pa'i dus su/ nub cig tshogs mchod kyi gral du me chen po bus gsungs nas bus pa la/ tshad pa tsha bsil yab de khyer la shog gsungs nas/ bsil yab phul bas g.yab par mdzad cing*/ rgya yul dbyar sos kyi tshad pa dang 'dra bar 'dug gsung ba la/ rtogs ldan mgon rgyal bas de ji ltar lags zhus pas/ rgya yul gyi tshad pa tsha dus bsil yab kyis g.yab kyang tsha 'ub 'ub byed pa las bsil ba'i snang ba ye med/ de bzhin du 'dir yang tsha 'ub 'ub byed gsungs/ yang rtogs ldan mgon rgyal bas/ drung nas dgung lo brgyad cu rtsa bzhi bzhugs pa'i lung bstan yod pa la lnga bcu rtsa drug las mi bzhugs pa ci lags zhus pas/ bla ma pa/ dge ba spyod pa nyung zhing sdig pa spyod pa mang bas skyo ba skyes pa yin mod gsungs/ yang drung nas bde bar gshegs pa'i dus su zla ba'i steng nas zhal mthong ba mang po byung 'dug pa drung nas zhal bstan pa lags sam zhus pas/ nged kyi tshad med pa'i snying rje dang khong rang rnams kyi dad pa la brten nas mthong ba mang po byung 'dug /de'i tshe hor sog rnams 'di bzhin byed kyin gda' gsungs nas/
dbu zhwa phyag g.yon du bzung*/ pus mo btsugs/ g.yas pa'i mdzub mos zla ba ston cing sku lus kyi rnam 'gyur yang mdzad do//

de nas bzhugs gdan la bzhugs te/ zla ba'i steng na 'dug pa yang nga yin/ seng ge'i steng na 'dug pa yang nga yin/ glang po che'i steng na 'dug pa yang nga yin gsungs/ yang drung nas bde bar gshegs pa'i bcu bzhi'i tho rangs kha/ rtogs ldan grags seng pa'i gzigs snang la/ drung nyid ras dkar po'i a ga ra zhig bsnams nas 'ja' 'od kyi nang na nam mkha' la bzhugs par mthong ba la khong gis zhus te/ drung nas nged bu slob rnams la thugs rjes gzigs nas mi bzhugs par/ bde bar gshegs pa ji ltar lags zhus pas/ drung gi zhal nas/ nga la bsam pa bzang po yod kyang*/ snyigs dus sems can gyi bsod nams la mi 'grub par 'dug /sdig spyod grangs mang bas skyo ba skyes pa yin/ da dga' ldan du 'gro gsungs pa zhig khong gi dag snang la byung 'dug pa/ drung nas de skad gsungs pa lags sam zhus pas/ de ltar yin mod/ nged skyo ba skyes nas song ba yin/ gzhan yang cang shes kyi rta dang*/ bya rgyal rgod po la sogs sgyu ma'i sprul bsgyur dang*/ dag pa lha sku'i sprul bsgyur la sogs pas/ dga' ldan du phyin pa'i tshul yang byas/ lar dga' ldan de thag ring po zhig na yod pa ma yin gsungs/ der phud cig drang ste/ mchod par zhu dga' ldan na phud yod lags sam zhus pas myos byed kyi chang 'di med/ lha'i bdud rtsi bya ba yod gsungs/ de nas gzhan dag the tshom bsal ba'i phyir/ co 'dri'i zhu phod cung zhig zhus te/ lha'i bdud rtsi kha dog nag po de bzang zer bar 'dug pa de ltar lags sam zhus pas/ bdud rtsi nag po'am de ngas ma mthong*/ kha dog dkar po 'o ma lta bu la ro mchog sna tshogs bro ba yin gsungs/ yang dga' ldan na rang re mi yul gyi mchod pa'i yo byad mtshal gung thang gi mchod pa'i dar gdugs la sogs pa de lta bu med mchi zhes zhus pas/ bla ma pa mi yul gyi 'dod yon kun g.yas chung*/ dga' ldan gyi me tog re re la yang lkog 'phreng tsam yod cing*/

de la sogs pa'i 'dod yon bsam gyis mi khyab pa yod pa yin gsungs/ yang rang re mi yul gyi yar chab gtsang po tsam gyi chu yang med/ kong po gsang dang rta mchog gi mkhar khang 'dra ba yang med zer/ de'i rgyu mtshan rang re mi yul gyi sgyed rdo ring mo can 'di 'dra ba'i rdo legs po yang med pa 'dra zhus pas/ bla ma pa/ dga' ldan gyi chu thams cad bdud rtsi yin/ mi yul gyi yar chab gtsang po 'dra ba ma yin/ dga' ldan na sa rdo 'di 'dra ba med/ sa rdo thams cad rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa yin/ bcom ldan 'das byams pa mgon po'i gzhal yas khang ngam/ byang chub sems dpa' blo gros rin chen gyi pho brang ngam/ sum cu rtsa gsum na rnam par rgyal ba'i khang bzang la sogs pa lha'i yul gyi gzhal med khang rnams rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa yin/ mi yul gyi mkhar khang 'dra ba g.yas chung gsungs/ yang dga' ldan na rta mchog gi rta rag pa 'dra ba'i rta bzang po yod dam zhus pas/ chos la dus tshod med na ban rgan 'chal pa yin/ de la mdzod gsungs/ thog ma med pas chos thams cad la dbang 'byor pa'i ye shes/ ji lta ba dang ji snyed pa'i gzigs pa rnam par dag pa brnyes kyang*/ skyes pa'i rabs rgya mtsho'i phreng ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa rnams su/ shes bya rig pa'i gnas du ma la rab tu byang par slob tshul ston cing*/ slob dpon dang slob ma'i 'brel pa mtha' yas pa sgrub par mdzad pa las/ 'dir yang thog ma kho nar rtogs ldan mgon rgyal ba la smin byed sogs su 'gro ba'i bka' brgyud rin po che'i man ngag snying po bla na med pa zab lam dpal ldan nā ro chen po'i chos drug gi skor ji snyed pa/ de bzhin du sbyor ba yan lag drug pa la sogs rdzogs rim gyi man ngag mang po dang*/ bcom ldan 'das ma lhan cig skyes ma/ bde dgyes rgyal ba rgya mtsho la sogs pa byin rlabs rmad du byung ba dang ldan pa'i bka' brgyud kyi thugs dam bskyed pa'i rim pa mang po dang*/

gzhan yang chos che phra du ma gsan par mdzad do// skabs 'di tsam na sngon gyi gsol ja bshāka seng gis nye gnas byas/ yang ri khrod de nyid du/ dge bshes yon tan rin chen gyis zhib dang chang phul ba'i dus su/ khyed rnams nyon/ nga'i pha byams pa mgon po yin/ sems can rnams la phan par bya ba'i don du 'ongs pa yin/ zhi ba byas na dus gsum mkhyen pa yin/ drag po byas na karma pak+ṣi yin gsungs/ ras pa so dkar gyis zhwa nag can du tsam 'ong ba lags zhus pas/ gang byas kyang nyan gsungs/ yang drung gi sku'i rim gro la ci 'dra byas na 'thad zhus pas/ nga'i rim gro bcom ldan 'das byams pa mgon po dang*/ spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug dang*/ 'od dpag med dang*/ gu ru pad+ma 'byung gnas rnams kyis byed kyin yod/ khyed gdul bya rnams kyis kyang gsol ba 'debs pa la sogs pa'i rim gro byas la 'gal ba med/ de nas spyan sngar yod pa rnams la dbu zhwa'i bstod pa gyis gsol ba thob/ yan lag bdun pa phul gsungs/ de ltar byas pas/ drung nyid kyang phyag dang phyag rgya mdzad cing 'dug pa la/ rjes su drung gi zhal nas/ khyed rnams phyag 'tshal ba dang gsol ba 'debs pa'i dus su nga'i snang ba la bcom ldan 'das mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug /gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje/ dpal rta mgrin/ u rgyan gu ru pad+ma 'byung gnas la sogs dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong thams cad yid la wal gyis byung nas phyag byas pa yin/ nga karma pak+ṣis lung bstan pa yin/ khyed rang rnams sgrub pa gyis/ zhwa nag po can la mos gus gyis gsungs/ yang dbu la phyag mdzub gtad de/ nga ma brjed par gyis gsungs/ yang phyag mdzub spyan g.yas pa la gtad nas/ cis kyang ma brjed par gyis la dad pa dang mos gus gyis shig gsungs/ yang dbyar gyi dus gcig than pa chen po byung ba la/ char 'bod pa mang pos char ma phebs te/ slob dpon sgom rin/

pag shi kun dga'/ sangs rgyas dpal rnams kyis yul mi'i zhu sna byas te char 'bebs pa'i zhu ba byas pa la/ khyed rang rnams yan lag bdun pa gyis shig gsungs nas/ de tshar ba dang*/ nga karma pak+ṣi'i skye ba yin na zhag gsum gyi nang na char chen po 'bab par gyur cig /de lta ma yin na char 'bru gcig kyang 'bab par ma gyur cig /ces bden pa bskul ba las zhag gnyis na char chen po bab bo// yang zla ba de'i phyi ma la/ char gyis phongs pa'i skye bo rnams la phan par dgongs nas/ gzim khang gi steng du byon zhing lho'i phyogs la gzigs te 'di ltar bcom ldan 'das byams pa/ yi dam rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro /chos skyong ma mgon la sogs pa rnams kyis char chen po dbab tu gsol/ zhes gsungs pas de phyin chad rang rang gi 'dod pa bzhin char chen po bab/ yang gnas de nyid du dben pa mdzad pa'i skabs shig /cung zad mnal ba sad pa dang thang shing chen po rnams la ma mgon dang*/ thar phran rnams dam can sogs 'jig rten pa'i chos skyong du gzigs/ yang lkog 'phrang du tshogs 'khor gyi gral du rin brtson gyis lta sgom spyod pa'i mgur zhus pa'i tshe/ dben gnas ri khrod 'grim pa la// mtha' brgyad bral ba'i lta ba gces// 'pho 'gyur med pa'i bsgom pa gces// sna tshogs lam khyer spyod pa gces// zhes gsungs/ slob dpon chen po gu'i gung pa pheb nas mjal te nges shes skyes/ sngon rang byung zhabs kyis lung bstan pa bzhin rnam thos tshal du pheb ste/ der bzhugs khri dang bzhugs khri'i rgyab kyi shugs pa'i sdong po dpang nyams par gyur cing chos khri der bzhugs nas chos gsung bar mdzad/ 'o thang gi rgyab tu chos rje gong ma'i chos khri byin rlabs chen po dang ldan pa yod de/ der bzhugs zhing chos gsungs pa'i tshe/ bzhugs khri rab tu g.yo ba khrom thams cad kyis mthong zhing gdul bya rnams kyi dad pa'i dbang po rab tu rgyas par mdzad do//

yang dgung lo bcur phebs pa'i tshe lkog 'phrang nas byon te ba ru snar ma phebs kyi bar du slob dpon chen po la/ rtogs ldan grags seng bde gshegs pa e yin zhes yang yang gsung ba la/ de mi gsung bar zhu sku khams bzang bar mchi zhus pas/ sku khams e bzang cha med/ nga'i snang ba la 'das snyam pa byung gsungs/ gsung ba kho na ltar dus mtshungs par snang ngo*/ /yang rin brtson gyis/ long po bcas sde nyang po la gdan 'dren gyi zhu ba byas pas ma gnang bar kho ngu ba la/ ma ngu rang gi sems la ltos// kha dog gzugs su grub pa med// sna tshogs ma nges cir yang 'char// bden med brdzun med glod la zhog/ ces gsungs/ yang stag lo la long por mtshur phu ba dge bshes blo gros seng ge dpon slob rnams kyis mjal nas/ mtshur phu nang pa da tsam gar sleb ang zhus pas/ lha sar sleb yod gsungs de kho na ltar tshes grangs 'grig go /yang zang zang ne'u ring pa'i zhu yig lan du/ 'khor 'das dbyer med rtogs na lta ba yin// snang stong zung 'jug rtogs na sgom pa yin// gang shar dbyings su rtogs na spyod pa yin// rang sems sangs rgyas su rtogs na 'bras bu yin// zhes gsungs/ chos rje gong mas lung bstan pa bzhin zho kha thang gi lha khang la rab gnas mdzad/ nags phu'i gzim khang du rtogs ldan ye rgyal ba/ dge bshes blo gros seng ge byang chub 'od rnams kyis nges don gyi tshigs bcad cig zhus par/ dang po'i tha mal shes pa 'di// chos sku yin par shes par mdzod// mi dran dgu dran rtog pa 'di// ye shes yin par shes par mdzod// sna tshogs snang ba dkar dmar 'di// bla ma yin par shes par mdzod// cal col smra ba mang po 'di// gsung rab yin par shes par mdzod// ces dang*/ gzhi lam 'bras gsum zhus par/ gzhi ni lus sems gnyis po yin// lam ni smin lam grol lam yin// 'bras bu sku gnyis thob pa yin// shes par mdzod cig 'gro drug rnams//

zhes dang*/ lta sgom spyod gsum zhus par/ lta ba snang stong dbyer med yin// sgom pa chos sku zag med yin// spyod pa 'gag med ye shes yin// dam tshig rnam dag dkar po yin// 'bras bu rang sems sangs rgyas yin// zhes gsungs/ gnas de nyid du rtogs ldan ye rgyal ba la dge bsnyen gyi gdams pa gsan/ de nas brtsams te/ bcom ldan 'das mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i rgyud 'grel dang*/ bde mchog gi skor la sogs pa sngags gsar ma dang*/ rdzogs pa chen po bi ma la snying thig mkha' 'gro snying thig la sogs gsang sngags rnying ma'i skor mang po yang gsan zhing*/ de bzhin du bla ma rdza gshongs ba shes rab dpal la'ang*/ bka' 'gyur ro 'tshal dang*/ bstan bcos dpag tu med pa'i lung yang gsan par mdzad cing*/ slob dpon blo gros seng ge la byams chos kyi skor ma lus pa gsan par mdzad do// de nas sngon rang byung zhabs kyis lung bstan pa bzhin shing gsom pa'i sdong po rtse mo kha brag can gyi rtse mo mtho dma' mnyam par gyur pa'i tshe snye bor byon te/ nyin pa'i yon bdag rnams kyis gdan 'dren zhus par chu phar kar mi 'gro bar chad kyi ltas byung gsung yang*/ dbon po tshul rdor na re khyed kyi gsung la'ang lan re tig po med/ zho kha thang nas nags phur mi 'gro bar chod 'ong gsungs pa la ci yang ma byung zer zhing kun gyis zhus kyang ma gnang bar/ drung pa dpon slob chu tshur ka nas byon/ mtshur phu ba dang*/ lha steng pa kun drung gi gsung la brten nas phyags phyir byon/ 'ga' res ma nyan par pha ri la phyin pas smyug thag gi phur pa bud nas btsun pa zhig chur lhung yang zin/ yul mi gcig chur shi /spyad pa mang po chu la shor/ yang ldang nga rdo rje dpal gyis zhus te gsungs pa/ bcom ldan thub pa chen po yis// brgyad khri bzhi stong gsungs pa yang*// sde snod gsum du 'dus pa ste// spang bya dug gsum yin pa'i phyir//

gsum yang bsdus na phyag chen yin// spang bya gsum yang rnam rig gi/ rtog pa dag tu 'dus pa ste// phyag chen ma bcos rang sems yin// gzhi ni lus dang sems nyid yin// lam ni bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug yin// 'bras bu sgrib bral sku gnyis yin// rnal 'byor bzhi gsum bcu gnyis sogs// nyams len dril na rang sems la// dran pas 'dzin zhing ma yengs par// 'jog pa theg pa'i mthar thug yin// zhes gsungs/ yang khe nang du yon bdag gcig gis gdan 'dren byung ba la/ mi 'gro lan mang du gsungs kyang zhu ba nan cher byed nas byon pa'i sar/ khang pa rdib pa'i 'og tu mi rta sum cu song pa la snad pa gcig kyang ma byung ngo*// de nas tsā ri tra ye shes kyi 'khor lor byon pa'i tshe/ bka' brgyud kyi bla ma yi dam chos skyong dang bcas pa zhal gzigs nas/ zung 'jug bde ba chen po'i pho brang nas// bde gshegs rdo rje 'chang la gsol ba 'debs// zhes sogs gsungs/ yang de nyid du bcom ldan 'das rdo rje rnal 'byor ma rigs bzhi mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams kyi bskor ba gzigs shing*/ bde chen 'gyur ba med pa don gyi rtogs pa mngon du gyur nas/ tsā ri'i gnas su rtsa rlung thig le bsgom// rang byung don dam rang byung rdo rjes rtogs// zhes sogs gsungs/ yang re zhig bla ma mgon rgyal bas/ drung pa rtsed mos grub thob 'ong ba lags sam zhus pa'i lan du/ phyag rgya chen po ma bsgoms kyang*// mtha' bral ngang la gnas shing gda'// gtum mo'i gdams pa ma bsgoms kyang*// bde chen sems la 'char zhing gda'// zhes bya ba la sogs pa gda' bdun rdo rje'i mgur dang*/ /'ong ba brgyad kyi mgur la sogs pa gsungs/ yang de nyid du/ nub bde ba can gyi zhing gi bkod pa bcom ldan 'das 'od dpag med rgyal sras rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyis bskor ba gzigs te/ nub cig gnyid kyi rmi lam na/ /bde ba can du phyin pa rmis/

/zhes sogs gsungs/ yang re zhig rdo rje rnal 'byor ma rigs bzhi mkha' 'gro dang bcas pas rdo rje'i mgur gsungs pa gsan te/ chos kyi dbyings ni 'dus ma byas/ /'gyur ba med par go bar gyis/ /zhes sogs so// yang de nyid du/ bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur ba mngon sum du gzigs te/ shes dang shes bya'i don kun rab gzigs pa'i/ /mgon po mchog zhal re zhig mngon sum bzhin/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa'o// gzhan yang tsā ri'i gnas kyi rang byon sngon gsal bar mi mthong ba rnams/ gsar du zhal phye zhing skal ldan rnams kyis zhus pa'am/ ma zhus par yang mgur dang tshigs su bcad pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa mdzad de/ der 'dus pa'i 'khor rnams yang dag pa'i lam la 'god par mdzad/ gnas de nyid du'ang*/ sngar gyi bla ma rnamal la gsung rab rgya mtsho gsan pa'i tshul mdzad cing*/ slob dpon tsā ri ston sngon la yang*/ ku ru kul+le'i sgrub thabs gsan/ re shig /bcom ldan 'das gsang ba ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma zhal gcig phyag bzhi rgyan du ma dang ldan pa/ ye shes kyi ḍā ki sprin gyi phung po gtibs pa lta bus bskor ba zhal gzigs/ yang ye shes ḍā ki stag gi gdong pa can gzigs shing*/ de'i sku rang byon yang gsal bar bstan/ yang bcom ldan 'das khros ma nag mo'i thugs ka na sngags kyi 'khor lo rab tu 'khor ba/ thugs kyi mkha' 'gro ma mthing nag bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba/ pheṃ kyi sgra 'brug lta bu sgrogs pa'i zhal gzigs/

yang nyin gcig /'byung po ma rungs pa a tsa ra'i gzugs su snang ba lnga brgya tsam snang ba la/ drung nyid ye shes kyi mgon po ber nag can du mdzad de/ gri gug gdengs pa'i 'od kyis kong lung pa la sogs 'jig rten thams cad rab tu gsal ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyi 'jug pa bstan/ yang rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras gnod sbyin du ma'i 'khor dang bcas pas/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che phul ba gzigs/ de nas sngon chos rje'i lung bstan dang mthun par la rgyab lhun grub steng du byon te/ der byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i zhing gi bkod pa rab 'byams gzigs/ yang de nyid du/ bla ma rnams la dag pa'i snang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa thugs la shar bar gyur cing*/ yon tan kun gyi mnga' bdag sangs rgyas kun gyi sku// sgrib gnyis dgra 'joms bden gnyis dam chos gsungs// spros pa'i mtshan ma kun spangs de nyid mkhyen pa'i thugs// bla ma'i sku gsung thugs la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces bya ba la sogs pa rtsa ba'i bla ma rnams la bstod pa pad+mo'i phreng ba mdzad/ yang zab lam nā ro'i chos drug gi khrid kyis skal ldan rnams tshim par mdzad pa na/ gzhan dag gegs sel ba'i man ngag mkhyen nam mi mkhyen the tshom du gyur te zhus pa la/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa dang*// bde chen dgyes pa he ru ka/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams la// sgo gsum gus pas gsol ba 'debs// zab mo gnad kyi chos drug gi/ dmar khrid mar gyi nying khu+u la// yengs med nyams len byas pa na// yon tan 'byung ba'i sngon du ni// gegs chen sna tshogs 'byung 'gyur bas// de la sel ba'i gdams pa dgos// ces pa la sogs pa gegs sel gnad gyi lde mig rdo rje'i mgur mdzad/ yang a wadhū ti sgra gcan gyi rtsar khams zla nyi'i dngas ma 'gyur med du gyur pas bde stong lhan cig skyes pa'i don mngon du gyur te/ man ngag gnad kyi lde mig gis//

rtsa sogs gsum po sgo phye nas// zag med bde la longs spyod pa'i// zhes sogs kyi mgur bzhengs/ de'i tshe/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dkar mo'i zhal gzigs/ gnas de nyid du'ang*/ sgom chen pa rnams la zhal ta'i mgur la sogs pa mgur mang du mdzad cing*/ dag pa'i snang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa gzigs/ de nas gdan sa chen po mtshur phu'i gdan 'dren pa rnams kyis yang nas yang du gsol ba btab pa la dgongs te/ rjes dgung lo bcu gsum bzhes pa chu 'brug lo la dbus su phyags bteg pa'i lam dwags po la phyung nas/ dpal zla 'od gzhon nu'i grub gnas dwags lha sgam por phyags phebs pa na/ ri bo de nyid rin po che'i mchod rten gyi rnam pa la/ rgyal ba sras bcas du ma dang*/ rgya bod kyi grub pa thob pa'i rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug du mas gang bar gzigs te/ bkra shis lhun chags sgam po'i ri// rje grub thob du ma'i tshogs kyis brgyan// e ma ngo mtshar mi che'am// zhes bya ba la sogs ri bo bdun gyi mgur gsungs/ de nas gdan sa dpal phag mo gru pa'i mdor/ rnam par mi rtog pa'i ting nge 'dzin mngon du gyur te/ yul dang yul can gnyis 'dzin kun tu rtog pa'i tshogs/ kun nas 'phro ba'i sgo la bsam gtan sgo glegs bcug/ mi rtog shes pa dngas pa'i dngas la gnas pa brten// de dag de yi ring por mi thogs rnam grol sku thob 'gyur// zhes gsungs/ de nas 'on gyi mda' tshong 'dus phrag khar bsam yas kyi bla ma mkhas grub pas mjal te/ sngar chos rje gong mas khong rang la gnang ba'i bka' shog rnams dang por gzigs su phul/ de rnams kyi rjes su chos kyi dri ba'i yi ge zhig phyag tu phul nas/ 'di'i lan zhig thugs la 'dogs par zhu zhes zhu ba phul ba la/ yun ring du ci yang mi gsungs/ yang nas yang du bskyar zhing phyag btsal nas zhus pas/ 'di yi lan khyod la/ lha sa lcang thang du btab tshar gsungs pas/

dad pa dpag tu med pa skyes te zhabs la gtugs shing mchi ma phyung nas the tshom dang bral bar gyur/ de'i tshe ta'i si tu byang chub rgyal mtshan pas bkur bsti phun sum tshogs pa bsgrubs shing*/ chos kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen pos tshim par mdzad/ 'di ta sis dbus gtsang gi bdag po byas nas lo bzhi pa'i steng yin/ de nas rim gyis lha sar phyags phebs te jo bo rin po che dang mjal ba'i tshe/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas du ma dag pa'i snang bar gzigs shing*/ mtshal gung thang du chos rje dge slong bas spyan drangs nas mjal/ sngon gyi gsung gleng mtha' dag mdzad cing*/ da ni rgan po shi yang sems kyi lhag pa med ces thugs tshim/ sku gsum bdag nyid 'gro ba'i mgon/ /zhes sogs pa'i mgur yang mdzad/ de nas mtshur gyi gnas nang du dang po phyags phebs te/ de'i tshe 'dir sgom chen pa phal gyis yi dam rje btsun ma la byed cing yod par 'dug gsungs/ de ci lags zhus pas/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bsu ba byed pa'i snang ba byung ba'i mod la 'di'i sgom chen pa rnams dang phrad gsungs/ der tshogs gral zhig tu bla ma dar rgyal ba la/ da nang spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la sprin gyi phung po du mas bskor 'dug snyams pa la/ de min par 'dug /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bskor ba yin par 'dug ces gsungs/ gnas nang gi gzim khang gong mar sngar rtogs ldan pa'i rus khang pa 'di'i rnam 'gyur 'di dang 'di 'dra ba yod pa la da 'di dang 'di lta bur 'dug /ces sogs sngon gyi tshul mang po gsungs nas/ gdul bya rnams nges shes skyed par mdzad/ de nyid du/ sku bzhi bdag nyid rgyal ba la// bdud bzhi'i nyon mongs zhi bya'i phyir// rab tu dang bas phyag 'tshal lo// gzhi ni dri ma dang bcas phyir// lam ni bskyed rdzogs rnam pa gnyis//

'bras bu don gnyis mngon du gyur// zhes sogs kyi mgur bzhengs/ gnas nang nas mtshur phur phebs pa'i lam du chos skyong gis bar chad bsal bar gzigs/ de nas gdan sa chen po dpal ldan mtshur phur phyags phebs pa'i tshe/ rgyal ba sras bcas bka' brgyud bla ma'i tshogs sprin gyi phung po gtibs pa lta bu zhal gzigs/ chos thams cad sgyu ma ltar mngon du gyur te/ byang chub lam zhugs dmigs dang mi dmigs thabs kyis sbyor ba la gnas pa/ /snang rig stong pa'i rtsal las sna tshogs snang gyur de dngos zhen pas bcings/ kun snang rig stong rmi lam ltar 'byongs rgyas sras mdzad pa mchog spyod pa/ /de 'dir ring por mi thogs srid pa'i chu ngogs las brgal 'phags mchog 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs/ de nas tshogs dge 'dun sgang pa'i mkhan chen rin po che don grub dpal dang*/ slob dpon gdan gcig pa jo btsun bsod nams 'bum dang*/ dus go ba gdan gcig pa gzhon nu dpal bas mdzad de/ sbrul lo zla ba gsum pa'i yar tshes la rab tu byung ba dang dge tshul gyi sdom pa bzhes/ mtshan dharma kīr+t+ti te dpal chos kyi grags pa zhes gsol te/ mkhan chen rin po che dang mjal ba'i dus/ dpal ldan dus gsum mkhyen pa nam mkha'i skar ma tsam gyi zhal gzigs shing*/ gzhan yang dag pa'i snang ba dpag tu med pa shar/ bla ma 'di la dam pa'i chos 'dul ba'i skor la sogs chos mang du gsan yang mtshur phu'i mdun gyi nags ri'i rtse la bcom ldan 'das spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug sku mdog dkar po 'od dang 'od zer du ma 'phro ba/ 'khor bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba gzigs/ mtshur phur sbrul lo zla ba gsum pa'i tshes bcu'i nyin/ da lta nyams kyi snang ba la// bde ba can gyi zhing khams na// sngo dang ser po la sogs pa'i// me tog rnam pa sna tshogs snang*// lha yi bu ni thams cad dag/ 'phags mchog rgyal po'i gsung thos kyang*// zhal ni ma mthong pa yis na//

sdug bsngal dag gis gzir bar mthong*// zhes dang*/ bla ma rgyal ba'i byin rlabs kyis// sgom chen rang byung rdo rje yi// thang gcig nyams kyi snang ba la// dus gsum mkhyen pa sku mdog dmar// phyag na rdo rje dril bu bsnams// 'od kyi dra ba'i nang na mdzes// zhes dang*/ dkon mchog gsum gyi byin rlabs kyis// rtogs ldan nub cig mngon sum gsal ba ru// sngon po dkar po'i 'od dang ldan// kun gyi mchog cig nga yis mthong*// spyan ras gzigs dbang 'od dpag med// sku mdog dkar po phyag bzhi ba// byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs rnams ni// sprin phung lta bus gtibs pa mthong*// zhes gsungs/ yang mtshur phur bzhugs dus zhig mnal lam du rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sku mtshon cha la sogs gsal pa dod pa zhig gzigs/ 'di yi dam gyi lha mtshan nyid pa min 'ong snyam pa dgongs nas/ rang nyid chos skyong du bsgyur nas 'jigs byed kyi gzugs de'i snying gar gri gug brgyab pas skad ngan phyung zhing gar song cha med gsungs/ yang mtshur phur/ dus re zhig gi tshe mnal lam du a tsa ra zhig byung*/ yang gnyis gsum la sogs pa nas mthar a tsa ras khang pa gang byung*/ de la rang nyid chos skyong du byas te gri gug gis de rnams kyi rke bcad de mgo rnams 'og dpang du lhung song ba la/ sdig sgra dang bcas pa byung*/ de dang mnyam du tshogs su gtor chen btang nas dge 'dun rnams kyis bdud bzlog bzhes sgra mdzad pas gnyid sad gsungs/ des nad yams zhig yod pa de myur du rgyun chad/ yang skabs zhig mnal lam du sbrul chen po stod lung gi lung par mi shong ba snyam byed pa tsam la/ mgo bo'i steng na me chen po rab tu 'bar ba zhig glags ltar byung ba las/ bya khyung du mdzad de gsol zhing ri bo mchog rab dang mtshungs pa'i ri chen po zhig gi steng na babs pa las/ bya khyung gi ljid kyis ri chen po de nyil nyil 'gro ba byung*/

yang bla ma dar rgyal ba la gsungs pa/ nga sgom chen pa rgan po rnams nub mo dge sbyor gyi rim ba ci ltar byed cing yod snyam nas ltar 'ongs pa'i tshe/ khyod dge sbyor 'di dang 'di 'dra ba byed cing 'dug la/ gzhan rnams kyang de dang de lta bu byed cing 'dug ces rgyu mtshan shin tu gsal bar bka' stsal/ mtshur phu nas bde chen du byon pa'i lam kar/ 'dam mgo spang gi chu mig mgron la byams kyi rtsar phyags phebs pa dang*/ bde chen nang pa la/ khyod kyi chu mgo 'dir ci mthong ba'am thos pa byung ngam gsungs/ ci yang mthong thos ma byung de ci lags zhus pas/ chu mig 'di'i nang du/ klu chen po brgyad kyi bteg pa'i pad+ma'i sdong po chen po zhig 'dug /de'i steng du bcom ldan 'das 'jam pa'i dbyangs sku mdog dkar po/ phyag g.yas mchog sbyin gyi steng du me tog ud pa la'i nang du ral gris mtshan pa 'dzin pa/ /phyag g.yon thugs kar chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya mdzad pas ut+pa la'i yu ba 'dzin zhing*/ de'i steng du glegs bam gyis mtshan pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo dkrung du bzhugs pa sku la rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ zhal nas zab mo stong pa nyid kyi chos gsungs pa zhig bzhugs 'dug /khyod rang rta las bob la khrus gyis chu 'thung gsungs nas de ltar du byas zer/ bde chen du byams pa dang spyan ras gzigs sogs yi dam mang po'i zhal gzigs/ der slob dpon chos rdor gnyid du song ba'i sngas mgor bud med chen mo zhig gis lag pa rkyong zhing 'dug /'dis khong la bar chod rtsom par 'dug snyam nas/ rang nyid khyung du byas te ded pas byang phyogs kyi brag de la thim song*/ khyung gi gshog pa gnyis kyis brag la brdab pas gshog pa'i bar nas me byung ste brag de thul gyis tshig song ba snyam byed pa dang shul der skad ngan mang po byung gsungs/ yang bde chen du sku mtshams mdzad pa'i skabs shig mnal lam du bde ba can gyi zhing khams gzigs/

der rin po che'i ljon shing rtsa ba pad ma rā ga /sked pa shel/ yal ga baiḍūr+ya/ lo ma gser las grub pa dang*/ rin po che'i snod du bdud rtsi yin zer ba dang*/ rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i me tog sna tshogs dang*/ lha rdzas phun sum tshogs pa mang po mthong*/ thugs dgongs la phyi'i 'di rnams mthong kyang nang gi ma mthong na mi 'ong snyam nas gzigs pas/ rin po che'i khang pa na/ ston pa tshe dpag tu med pa bzhugs pa dang mjal nas chos gsung bar zhus pas/ der tshe'i bum pa mgo thog tu bzhag ste dbang bskur/ tshe'i bum pa'i bdud rtsi lag mthil du'ang gnang*/ yang gnas de nyid du sku 'khor shin tu mang po gzim khang chung ngu'i chung ngur bzhugs kyang*/ dog pa dang mi shong ba med pa'i rdzu 'phrul bstan te/ re gos sum brtsegs gon pa dang*/ gos dar sum brtsegs gon pa gnyis/ /khyad par med pa'i gdengs zhig dgos/ /zhes pa nas/ yangs dog med pa'i gnas su sbyar/ /zhes pa'i bar gyi mgur gsungs/ yang yum chen mo gser btso ma'i kha dog lta bu/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas du mas bskor ba'i zhal gzigs shing*/ 'dir ni zab mo'i gcod nyid bshad// nyon mongs 'joms pa gcod kyi mchog/ gcod ston pa ni rgyal ba nyid// gcod ni rtog ge kun las 'das// zhes gsungs pa gsan/ yang bcom ldan 'das ma ku ru kul+le 'od zer dmar po lcags kyu lta bu 'jig rten thams cad du mngon par 'phro zhing*/ gtso mo lta bu'i 'khor mkha' 'gro ma du mas bstod pa'i dbyangs rab tu sgrogs pa gzigs/ yang tho rangs zhig mnal lam du bde chen gyi rgyab ri 'di 'dra ba'i mtho zangs nge ba zhig gi steng du 'dzeg phyin pas/ khang bzang dmar zang nge ba sgo dang nge 'dug /ngas de la ltas kyin phyin pas/ dbus su rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i mdun du mchod pa mang po bshams te g.yas g.yon du/ tai lo pa/ nā ro pa/ bir wa pa/ sa ra ha/ mi tra dzo ki la sogs pa'i grub thob kyis gzhal yas khang dang bar snang thams cad

kyang khengs nas snang ba de re res/ rdo rje'i glu dang tshigs su bcad pa re re yang gsungs zhes gsungs/ de nas phung po ri bo che nas mkhas grub g.yung ston pa gdan 'dren btang nas byon te mjal la khad kyi nyin zhag mang por/ chos rje'i drung nas zhi khro'i lha tshogs skar ma'i tshogs lta bu zhal mngon sum du gzigs/ thugs dam nan tar bzang po byung gsungs/ bla ma pa phebs te/ chos rje'i drung du/ nga rgad por song yang chos rje gong ma sku drin che ba la bsams nas thag ring po nas 'ongs pa yin pas/ chos rje pa'i drung nas/ gong ma kun gyi yin lugs zhig gsung bar zhu zhus pas/ chos rje'i zhal nas/ rje dus gsum mkhyen pa dang*/ chos rje gong ma gnyis kyi dus ni gsal sing nge ba mi dran par 'dug /nga karma pak+ṣi'i dus su rgya mtsho la thug gi bar gyi hor sog la sogs gdul bya ma rungs pa rnams la gang la gang 'dul bgyis nas thams cad dbang du bsdus shing zil gyis mnan pa kun ni legs par dran gsungs/ g.yung ston pas chos rje'i zhabs la 'jus shing bshum par mdzad do// bla ma 'di'i drung du/ so'i rig pa gcer mthong gi bskor/ don brgyud rdzogs pa dang*/ kam gyi sdug bsngal zhi byed kyi skor/ bden bzhi'i chos rdzogs pa dang*/ rma la gsungs pa'i phyag rgya chen po sher phyin gyi skor rdzogs pa dang*/ brgyud pa phyi ma'i chos skor te mdor na pha dam pa rgya gar gyi chos skor gyi dbang bka' man ngag lung thams cad rdzogs pa dang*/ rdo rje phreng ba dang dus 'khor yongs rdzogs/ mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho/ dbang brgya rtsar grags pa/ sbyong rgyud kyi dbang bcu gnyis/ mdo sgyu sems gsum/ mkha' 'gro snying thig sogs gsang sngags snga 'gyur phyi 'gyur gyi dbang man ngag lung rjes gnang ste mdor na rdo rje theg pa'i chos skor rdzogs par gsan no/ /chos gsan pa'i tshul zhib mo ni gsan yig las rtogs par bya ba nyid de 'dir smos kyis ma lang ngo*//

yang skabs shig mnal lam du bya khyung du sprul nas rgya gar du byon pas/ grub thob sku che zhing yan lag rags pa rgyan drug btags pa gzi mdangs can zhig dang mjal/ khyed su lags zhus pas/ nga sa ra ha yin gsungs/ 'o na phyag chen gyi gdams ngag zhu byas pas/ chos thams cad yid la mi byed pa do ha'i don yin pas sgoms shig gsungs/ yang nub cig spyan ras gzigs dang mjal bar byed dgos dgongs nas rmi lam bzung bas/ mtsho'i steng na rin po che las grub pa'i pad+ma'i steng du/ phyag brgyad yod pa'i spyan ras gzigs zhig dang mjal gsungs/ yang bde chen du sku grib la brten pa'i mgul cham zhig bsnyun pa'i tshe/ thugs dam la bzhugs pa'i gzigs snang du/ sangs rgyas sman gyi bla sku mtshan dang dpe byad kyis brgyan pa/ phyag na shel gyi bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba bsnams pa zhig mngon sum du byon nas zhal du bdud rtsi gnang*/ sku khrus gsol ba snyam byed pa na/ cham pa de drag 'dug gsung nas sku bkrag mdangs dang ldan pa zhal zil pa phram me bzhugs 'dug zer/ yang bde chen du karma nang pa tshul khrims dpal bas gtso mdzad/ gdan 'dren du 'ongs pa'i khams pa rnams la phyag na rdo rje'i lung zhig gsungs pa'i tshe/ dkon mchog gzhon nu pa'i thugs dgongs la/ phyag g.yon pa'i dril bu dkur brten gsungs pa'i sku'am de gang la zer snyam pa na/ chos rje'i drung nas bzhengs te phyag dang sku lus kyi rnam 'gyur mdzad de dku de 'di la zer ba yin gsungs/ de phyin chad the tshom dang bral bar gyur/ yang re zhig na spyan ras gzigs su sprul te dmyal ba'i 'jig rten du phyin pas/ der lcags sreg gi khang pa gru bzhi pa/ ngos re re la yang dpag tshad mang po srid du yangs shing 'phang mtho ba sgo du ma dang ldan pa/ sgo re re yang gshin rje'i skyes bu rab tu 'jigs pa mtshon cha du ma thogs pa rnams kyis nye bar bsrung ba'i nang na sems can dpag tu med pa dag lcags sreg gi sa gzhi la rab tu rdeg cing sdug bsngal kyi tshor ba rab tu mi bzad pas gzir ba mthong ste/

snying rje chen po'i shugs kyis phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi thugs rje bskul/ sgyu ma'i rnam 'phrul gyi ting nge 'dzin dang*/ smon lam gyi mthus dmyal me zhi bar byed pa bdud rtsi bsil ba'i char rgyun rab tu drag po phab pa las/ skad cig de la dmyal ba'i me rab tu zhi ste/ lcags khang 'bar ba yang lha'i gzhal med khang du gyur/ sems can dmyal ba pa de dag mchog tu bde ba'i tshor ba dang ldan par gyur nas/ kho bo la phyag 'tshal zhing bstod pa byas te/ kho bos kyang de dag la gdams pa dang rjes su bstan par byas gsungs/ yang skabs zhig khyung du sprul nas u rgyan du byon te/ rdo rje phag mo'i zhabs la mgo bos phyag byas te gdams ngag zhu zhus pas/ sems skye med kyi ngang la zhog /skabs su bskyed rim bzlas brjod gyis/ tshogs dang gtor ma brtson na zhag brgyad nas 'grub ces gsungs/ de'i nub mo dam pa dang mjal nas chos kyi gnad cig zhu zhus pas/ lus la ma chags sems dum bur thong*/ zhes sogs mang du gsungs te gzhan rnams ma dran gsungs/ yang nub cig bya khyung du sprul nas dga' ldan du byams mgon dang mjal/ de'i g.yas na lha'i bu dri ma med pa bya ba zhig 'dug /g.yon na yang lha'i bu zhig 'dug /g.yas pa de la khyod su yin byas pas/ nga grags pa seng ge bya ba yin zer/ khyod sa tshod gar sleb byas pas/ sa dang po pa yin zer/ lha gzhan de su yin ma dris gsungs/ yang po ta lar phyin/ de'i pho brang thams cad brtsegs mar 'dug /'og ma shel las grub pa'i nang du 'phags pa phyag bzhi pa dkar po/ de'i gong ma pad+ma rā ga las grub pa'i nang du/ 'phags pa yang dmar po/ de'i gong ma gser las grub pa'i nang du 'phags pa yang ser po/ de'i gong ma ljang gu'i nang du 'phags pa yang ljang gu /de'i gong ma baiḍūr+ya las grub pa'i nang du 'phags pa yang sngon po/ snod bcud thams cad snang la rang bzhin med pa 'ja' tshon lta bur

'dug /de rnams dang mjal dus bde stong phyag rgya chen por lhan lhan 'gro bar 'dug gsungs/ yang gnas nang gzim khang 'og ma ru mi ma yin 'ga' re 'du yin 'dug /gser 'bum de'i sar 'gro mi phod par 'dug gsungs/ yang re zhig gi rmi lam du/ dga' ldan du byams mgon dang mjal ba de'i zhal snga nas/ dzam bu gling nas 'dir 'ong tsa na/ rin po che'i pad+ma la brdzus te skye ba yin gsungs/ der skye ba'i pad+ma de nges pa zhig bya dgos snyam nas 'dun pa gtad par/ rin po che'i pad+ma kha dog rgyas pa'i rtsa na 'dug /'dun pa de gal che bar 'dug gsungs/ yang gnas nang du bzhugs pa'i tshe/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing dpag tu med pa gzigs te/ khyad par du 'di nas shar gyi phyogs dpal gyi snying pos rab tu rgyas pas brgyan pa zhes bya ba'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing na bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dpal dam pa'i snying gi mun pa mtha' dag rab tu sel ba/ rin po che 'od kyi gtsug ces bya ba/ rgyal sras byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs 'ba' zhig la theg pa chen po kho na'i chos gsungs pa gzigs par gyur to// yang skabs shig mnal lam du/ rgyal ba rigs lnga'i zhing sbyong ba mdzad de/ de yang dang por sangs rgyas rnam par snang mdzad kyi zhing du byon te/ chos kyi tshogs du ma gsan zhing skad cig gis de dag thams cad rang nyid la bsdus te/ rang nyid bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad du mdzad nas zhing khams rgya mtsho'i bkod pa dang*/ 'khor rgya mtsho rab tu bsdu ba dang*/ chos kyi 'khor lo bla na med par rab tu bskor ba'i mdzad pa bstan zhing*/ slar yang rang gi sku'i rtsa khams ji snyed pa de thams cad du/ rgyal ba rnam par snang mdzad kyi sku 'khor zhing gi bkod pa mtha' yas pa rab tu snang bar mdzad do/ /ji ltar stong gsum rdul phra rab tu shong ba'i bkod pa bzhin/ de nas de thams cad kyang mchog tu zhi zhing spros pa mtha' dag gis rab tu dben pa chos dbyings ye shes shin tu zab mo'i dbyings su snyoms par zhugs pa'i tshul mdzad do/

/de bzhin du mi bskyod pa/ rin chen 'byung ldan/ snang ba mtha' yas/ don yod grub pa rnams la'ang*/ rim pa ji lta bas gzhan dang*/ rang dang*/ nang dang*/ gnyis ka dang*/ ye shes kyi 'jug pa ste lnga lnga sbyar nas mdzad de/ de thams cad yongs su rdzogs par sbyong ba yang skad cig yud tsam la grub par gyur to zhes gsungs so// yang bla ma dar rgyal ba la khyod la da ltar gyi snang ba 'di cir snang gsungs pa la/ nged la da lta'i snang ba 'di sgyu ma rmi lam lha sku gang dang gang du bsgoms pa der snang zhing dran pas ma zin pa'i tshe/ snang ba rang ga ma 'di kho nar gda' drung gis gzigs pa la ji ltar lags zhus pas/ kho bo la dus thams cad du snang ba 'di dag thams cad chu'i zla ba dang me long gi gzugs brnyan bzhin gsal stong 'dzin pa med pa'i ngang nas/ dag snang ye shes kyi 'khor lo 'ba' zhig tu yod pa yin/ 'ga' zhig gi bsam pa la kho bo sa gcig tu bsdad na legs snyam pa 'dug ste/ kho bo rgyal khams thams cad du 'gro dgos pa zhig yin/ kho bo gang dang gang gis mthong ba dang thos pa thams cad kyang dga' ldan nam bde ba can du 'dren pa la the tshom med pa yin zhes gsungs/ yang mnal lam du rgyal chen rigs bzhi dang*/ sum cu rtsa gsum la sogs pa 'dod pa dang gzugs na spyod pa'i lha gnas 'og min la thug pa'i bar rnams su rim gyis ting nge 'dzin rtsal sbyong zhing gshegs pa las/ gnas de dang de dag tu 'khod pa'i lha rnams kyis mchod pa dang bstod pa dpag tu med par byas shing*/ 'og min du rgyal ba longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku la theg pa chen po gsang sngags kyi chos du ma gsan par mdzad/ yang de nyid du bka' brgyud bla ma rgyal ba sras bcas du ma'i zhal gzigs/ snang rtse brag mig tu rgyal ba rgya mtsho lha lnga zhal gzigs/ mdor na yi dam gyi lha zhal gzigs pa sogs kyi tshul ni dag pa ye shes kyi 'khor lo la dbang 'byor pa'i gang zag rnams kyi skad cig re re'i tshul yang su zhig gis bgrang bar nus/

'on kyang tshur mthong gi gdul bya dag gi ngor cung zad gsungs pa dag rnam thar rnams su bkod par zad de/ rnam thar mthong ba don ldan na yi dam gyi lha zhal gziḍa rgyun chad med par snang na'ang*/ gzhon nu'i dus ci tsam gsung ba 'di rnams min pa zhal gyis mi bzhes par mngon shes dang zhal gzigs thams cad sprin gyi mtshan ma dang*/ mnal lam la bsnyad pa'i zol gyis cung zad zhal du shor ba ma gtogs ye mi gsung bar 'dug go /zhes 'byung ba bzhin no// khyad par mnal lam la mnga' brnyes pa'i tshul bstan te/ phyag dpe gzigs bzhed pa'i po ti du ma zhal phye ste sku 'khris kyi phyogs so sor bkram/ mnal lam du sku'i bkod pa mdzad ste gzigs pas mnal las bzhengs pa na thams cad thugs su chud de 'ong*/ dang por phyogs bcu re rer lus kyi bkod pa bcu bcu bkye/ des sangs rgyas tha dad pa bcu re la chos mi 'dra ba bcu re nyan pa la sbyangs pas dang por ni dka' ba ltar byung*/ 'bad rtsol skyed pas myur du 'byongs te da lta ni phyogs bcu re rer yang lus kyi bkod pa grangs med 'gyed cing sangs rgyas grangs med mchod/ chos grangs med 'dzin pa la dka' ba med de/ mdor na nga'i rmi lam sprul sgyur dang sgyu ma shin tu byang pos sgyu ma ston pa la khyad med pa yin gsungs/ des na gzhung lugs rnams la sbyangs pa'i tshul mdzad pa rnams kyang mnal lam gyi rtsal kho nas mdzad pa shas che zhing tshul des rig pa'i gnas tha dag la mkhyen pa'i dkyil 'khor mchog tu rgyas te tha na yig rigs kho na'ang drug cu tsam mkhyen gsungs/ de nas ngom shod dang gtsang gi byang rgyab la 'gro don lan re byon/ dpon chen rgyal bzang la sogs pa'i chen po thams cad dbang du 'dus/ mtshur phur gzhal yas khang gsos/ rgyal bu rat+nas gsan nas 'bul chen byung*/ gong du gsan yang sgro 'dogs ma chod pa la deng chung dbus nas gong na sleb dus dris pa la/

tshal pa si tu chos rje gong ma'i slob ma dngos shes rab che dam tshig gtsang ba na re/ chos rje gong ma yin nges su 'dug zer/ rtog dpyod can gzhan thams cad kyang rtsod med du ngo mtshar gleng gi 'dug byas pas gong ma phyag thal mo sbyar nas mchi ma byung*/ des mdun gyi mi chen thams cad kyang de ltar gyur te hor rgyal pos bla ma'i mtshan gsan pas spyan chab phyung ba 'di las med skad/ mtsho mo ru chung sogs byang rgyud mtha' dag tu gzhan don mdzad/ gnam mtsho se mo dor bde mchog yab yum la dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma du mas bskor ba zhal gzigs/ zho den mo cher so so yang dag rig bzhi'i don ji lta bar gzigs/ mtsho mo ru chung gi 'gram du gnas pa rnam pa gsum gyi don thugs su chud nas mgur bzhengs/ ngang pa'i stod du thub pa'i dbang po 'khor bcas zhal gzigs/ gzhan yang byang phyogs kyi rgyud de dag tu dag pa'i snang ba mang po dang*/ theg pa chen po'i don rab 'byams yid la shin tu gsal bar snang ngo*/ /zhes gsungs/ de nas dgung lo bco brgyad pa me mo bya'i lo khrums zla ba'i tshes brgyad la sngar gyi mkhan slob dang*/ gzhon nu dpal gyis gsang ston mdzad nas rnam dag sdom ldan nyi shu'i dbus su bsnyen par rdzogs par mdzad/ sha chang gi dri bro ba tsam yang sku'i nye lam dang gzigs sar mi 'grim/ sku 'khor rnams la sha chang gi ston mo mi byed pa sogs theg chen so thar gyi bcas pa dang thun mong gi 'dul ba'i bcas pa shin tu phra ba yan chad la nan tan du mdzad cing*/ sku 'khor yang dge slong dag pa tshul ldan mang thos kyi bsam gtan pa rig grol gyi spobs pa can 'ba' zhig tshogs/ lo 'dir dpal ldan bla ma bsod nams rgyal mtshan dang mjal/ phyag rtse sprod du mdzad/ 'jam dbyangs dmar po'i sgrub thabs kyi chos 'brel yang gsan/ skyor mo lung pa la 'bri nang gi sa dmag rdeg par byung nas skyi shod kyi lha sde thams cad kyis spyi zhus byas te lha sa rkyang thang du spyan drangs/

mi chen thams cad zil gyis mnan te dmag rang sar zhi kun gyis spyi bor khur/ snye thang rgya grong du gong mo'i sku rim chen mo la gsang zul bde gsum sogs tshogs pa khri phrag mang po'i dbu la khri gsum bshams pa'i dbus ma la rje nyid dang*/ g.yas su dpal ldan bla ma dam pa/ g.yon du bzhi thog pa bzhugs/ khrom thams cad kyang dad pa'i 'ur langs te gsol ba 'debs pa'i 'ur dir du song*/ bde chen du bzhugs pa'i skabs shig ta'i tu'i pho brang dang*/ gzhan yang mkhar mig dpag tu med pa'i ming gsungs shing*/ de rnams kyis gzhi'i dbyibs/ mkhar gyi rgya khyon/ khang pa'i rtseg mtho dman/ mi'i grangs mang nyung sogs so sor gsungs nas/ slob dpon sgom rin pa la yid la zhog cig phyin dus 'dra'am mi 'dra ltos shig gsungs pas ji ltar gsungs pa bzhin du byung*/ de nas gong ma mi'i dbang po ji gin gan gyi brgyud pa bcu bzhi pa/ tho gan the mur zhes pa dang*/ rgyal bu ā yu ta ra hwang them tshe zhes pa'i chos rgyal byang chub sems dpa' yab sras kyis lung dang ling ji lag rtags/ gser bre dngul bre gos dar mang po'i gnang sbyin sogs bskur nas/ di'i ju dpen dbon dang*/ kar sde'i mi dpon dkon mchog rgyal mtshan sogs hor bod kyi gser yig pa mang po gdan 'dren du btang ba bya lo la chos rje'i drung du sleb/ de'i 'ja' sa la/ tshe ring gnam gyi she mong la bsod nams chen po'i dpal la brten nas rgyal po nged kyi lung*/ rol pa'i rdo rje la gsol pa/ nged kyi mgo byas gdul bya mang po la dgongs te/ khyed bod phyogs su skye ba bzhes nas mtshur phu'i dgon par bzhugs zhes thos/ de'i don la sngar gyi yon tan dang phrin las la bsam nas/ sems can mang po'i don la ding ju dang dkon mchog rgyal mtshan gyis mgo byas gser yig pa rnams gdan 'dren du btang yod pas/ da lta snyigs ma'i dus 'dir sdug bsngal gyi gzir ba'i sems can la dgongs te/

'di phyogs kyi skal pa dang ldan pa'i gdul bya rnams la chos kyi bdud rtsis tshim par mdzad pa dang*/ lam gol lam stor ba'i sems can rnams kyi 'dren pa mdzad pa'i don la/ rang yul spang nas sku lus kyi tshegs la mi lta bar myur du 'byon par zhu zhing*/ yang thub pas gzhan don du dgongs nas sdug bsngal dang du blangs te/ yul khams thad thad du sems can gyi don mdzad pa thugs la gsal mod/ sku khams kyi 'tsho skyong*/ chos kyi bshad nyan/ bod phyogs rkyang pa la zhen par ma mdzad par/ 'di nas mngags pa'i gser yig pa der sleb pa'i thad du/ nged la bsam nas/ 'di phyogs su mjal ba'i dus su sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rgya cher ci nus su dar bar byed cing*/ sems can mang po thar pa'i lam la dgod pa la dgongs te/ bsnyad mi mdzad pa myur du 'byon pa/ slob dpon chen po rol pa'i rdo rje mkhyen/ mchod pa'i chas dang*/ 'ja' sa'i rten la gser bre gcig dngul bre gsum/ gos phyi nang dgu tshan gnyis yod/ sprel lo zla ba bcu pa'i tshes bcu la ta'i tu nas bris pa'i 'ja' sa bkra shis par gyur cig /bya ba yod/ bya lo'i ston yar klung ta sis rdzong pa'i 'bul chen 'bul/

dgung lo bcu dgu pa sa khyi zla ba dang po dang gnyis pa'i mtshams su lha sa gung thang du spyan drangs/ tshal pa dang 'bri gung pas zhabs tog cher byas/ slar mtshur phu nas zla ba lnga pa'i tshes nyi shu la chags bteg /'dam gyi snying drung zhes par bzhugs dus/ sgar gyi nye logs su thog chen po bab cing*/ sems can la'ang ma gnod pa'i tshe/ chos rje'i drung nas rten 'brel shin tu bzang*/ gong ma sku khams bzang pa'i drung du mjal zhing bstan pa'i bya ba'ang 'grub par gda' gsungs so// de nas dbus gtsang gi mi chen rnams kyis bsu skyel dang zhabs tog byas te/ kong dgon du rin po ches dbu mdzad dge 'dun rnams la/ dbang gdams ngag sems bskyed sogs chos kyis tshim par mdzad/ chos rje gong ma bas kyang non che thugs zhib phrin las che bar byung*/ mtshur kar gyi nang sos lam gyi gros dang sku rim zhu bar brtsam pa mkhyen nas/ khyed rang tsho gros mang mi dgos nga'i rjes su shog gsungs/ cog rtse la gong du char ches pas nag chu la mi thar zer ba na chu chung du 'gro gsung ste/ sang nyin chu chung ngus ltar gyur/ gzhi bdag gis chos yon du chu bsgyur ba yin gsungs/ de nas byang nam ra sogs brgyud de 'gro don dpag med mdzad cing*/ shag gi sa char rje nyid sngon rgyal po yul 'khor srung gi sras mchog gi blo gros su gyur pa gsal bar dgongs pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa stong gi nges pa'i tshul bstan pa zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos mdzad/ sha pho nas gser yig pas 'u lag chibs pa zhus pas sems can la gnod 'tshe mi byed/ khyed rang rnams kyang 'u lag ma zhon gsungs/ khal gzhon za ma thams cad nang nas gnang*/ za ma 'u lag ma dgos pas 'ja' mo ba thams cad dga'/ rgya tsho ya gsum dmag 'jam sogs 'jam che chung thams cad tu bsnyen dang 'bul pa mtha' yas/ ngo lkog gang du'ang sgar du sha mi 'grim pa'i bca' ba dam pas dud 'gro dpag med gyi srog thar zhing snyan pa mtha' yas/

zla ba drug pa'i tshes brgyad la sog zam khar pheb/ der byang chub kyi lam bstan pa zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos mdzad/ mtsho la me 'bar/ ga re/ go be/ chom la kha rnams su hor bod mang po dang*/ sgom sde ras tshang pa sogs kyis so sor mdzo rta ber khrab gos dar gnag lug khri ra can dang*/ brgya 'bul stong 'bul byas shing sems bskyed man ngag bzlas lung la sogs gang la gang mos kyi chos bstan/ srog sdom dang ma ṇi 'bum ther bye ba dung phyur la sogs dge rgyun mang du btsugs par mdzad/ gnas so so'i mi ma yin pa rnams kyis kyang gus pas btud/ de nas gdan sa karma dang*/ lha steng du byon te/ stom par yan/ sbu bo tshun gyi dad 'dun 'dus pa'i ban skya 'dus pa rnams la/ nā ro chos drug sogs dbang po dang 'tsham pa'i chos bstan te/ la la ni/ ldan rang grol du song zhing bsgrub pa'i dam bca' 'bul ba dang*/ nges 'byung gis yul zhing longs spyod rnams bor te rab tu 'byung ba dang*/ gzhan la 'tshe ba'i bsam sbyor spangs nas khyim pa byang sems kyi brtul zhugs 'dzin pa sogs te/ mdor na mjal tshad ngan 'gro'am 'khor ba gang rung las thar nas thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang la 'god par mdzad/ karmar mgon po byams pa byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba zhal gzigs nas/ rang sems gdod nas dag pa chos kyi dbyings zhes sogs gsungs/ yang de'i tshe 'phags ma sgrol ma rig pa'i lha mo du mas bskor ba gzigs te/ rin chen ri bo'i dbus na lhun po dang*/ /zhes sogs gsungs/ rten rnams la rab gnas mdzad pa'i tshe/ rgyal ba sras bcas rnams kyis me tog gi char 'bebs par gzigs te/ bkra shis gang zhig gdod nas rnam dag pa/ /zhes sogs gsungs/ yang spyan ras gzigs zhal gzigs nas chos kyi snying po mdor bsdus pa zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos mdzad/ yang shākya'i rgyal po gzigs shing snod bcud phra rags kyi bkod pa thugs la shar nas 'jig rten chags tshul mi 'dra ba'i 'dod pa brjod pa zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos mdzad/

lha steng du 'jam dbyangs dkar po zhal gzigs nas bstod pa mdzad/ yang de nyid du rdo rje lus kyi dkyil 'khor gsal bar gzigs te/ he ru ka dpal mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bcas g.yo med bde ba'i bdag /ces sogs gsungs/ yang rdzogs pa chen po thod rgal gyi rtogs pa mngon du gyur te/ rang sems snying po stong gsal kun tu bzang*// gdod nas dag pa rdzogs pa chen po'i dbyings// gzhi lnga'i gdangs las rang gsal kun tu khyab// 'od lnga'i gdangs la rang gnas mnyam par bzhag/ ces sogs gsungs/ karmar tshogs pa khri tsho tsam la chos gsungs tshe/ gser yig pas nam mkhar nyi zla'i bar na shel gyi mchod rten steng drung bzhugs par ring zhing mthong*/ 'di skabs zhig tu rgya gar gyi dzo gi lnga 'ongs te nged rnams rgya nag ri bo rtse lnga la 'gro 'di byang chub kyi shing la 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis phyag brkos mdzad pa yin pas re zhig phyag tu 'chol/ nged rang lnga ga ma 'dzom gyi bar su la'ang mi gtod pa zhu zer nas jo bo gan+dho la phul/ de rnams chos skyong gi sprul par grags te phyis gar song ma rnyed/ de nas bzung ste mchod yul gyi gtso bor mdzad nas nyin re zhing mchod pa thun res kyis brje ba dang*/ nyin mtshan du thun bzhir phyag dang bskor ba mdzad/ des sku 'khor thams cad kyang yid bskul te dge ba la rtse gcig par gyur/ de nas zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i tshes gcig la 'dan klong thang du pheb gling gi dpon chen du dben sha cha'o tha'o sogs kyis mjal/ byang lam la 'byon par zhus kyang 'dir 'gro don che gsungs nas kre la byon/ lcags mo si tu khri dpon stong dpon sogs/ tsha 'phrang shal khog gi mi dpon ban skya rnams dang*/ kre'i sa char/ rnam rgyal bla ma dpal ldan pa dpon slob sogs dad ldan gyi gdul bya rnams kyis 'bul nod bkur sti rgya chen po bsgrubs la/ rang rang gang 'dod kyi chos dang zang zing gi sbyin pas tshim par mdzad/

bla ma dpal ldan pa sogs kyis zhus pa'i ngor/ chos kyi gtam dam pa dgyes pa'i sgron ma zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos mdzad/ de nas tsha 'phrang brgyud de rma chu gling khugs su phebs par nye ba na/ rang re rta kha bag tsam thal 'dug /lho pha gi na 'bo gangs dkar yod pa la sgom zhing sdod rgyur da shing kun bar du 'gro ba las 'os med gsungs/ 'di'i dus hor yul du ti shri kun dga' rgyal mtshan gshegs/ sog po'i ming dpon ngo log pho brang shang to bsregs pa mkhyen par 'dug /khyi lo bcu gnyis pa'i nyer lnga la rma chu gling khugs su phebs/ der chos khri chen po brtsigs nas gdul bya rnams la sems bskyed sogs chos 'khor rgya chen bskor/ sa phyogs de nyid du lhog pa mang sa zhig yin par snang ba la de phyin lo 'gar lhog pa'i gnod pa ma byung zer/ de'i dbyar der chos khri'i rtsa bar sngar skye ma myong pa'i me tog rtsa ba gcig la sdong bu brgya yod pa/ sdong bu re rer me tog brgya brgya yod pa/ me tog re la 'dab ma ser po stong stong yod pa'i lte ba dmar po la ge sar ser po yod pa zhig skyes byung pa la/ mthong zhing thos pa thams cad ngo mtshar skyes te/ kyu ra ston pa dge bshes zhig gis gzhan mang po la phan sems kyis me tog gi rnam pa de spar du btab nas kha yig byas te yul grong rnams su 'grim pas/ de mthong tshad kyang thar pa'i khams brtas par mdzad do// phag lo zla ba gnyis pa'i tshes drug la bya khar phebs/ rgyal bu saṅgha shrīs bsus te la bar rgyal bu'i lha khang du phebs pa'i tshe/ mgon po ma pham pa zhal gzigs shing smon lam gyi tshigs bcad dang*/ mdor bsdus pa'i chos kyi gtam mdzad/ kha bre'i ri la bzhugs pa'i tshe/ ston pa 'khor bcas zhal gzigs/ de nas kan ci'u zhes bya ba'i yul du dharma shrī tsing wang zhes pa'i rgyal brgyud chen po dang*/ h+ying dben gyi khrims ra yod pa'i mi dpon gyi mgo byas gdul bya dpag tu med pas 'bul nod zhabs tog rgya chen po byas te thams cad smin grol la 'god par mdzad/

de rnams su cha ga pa'i gnod pas nyi ma 'grib ba byung ba zhus/ bka' shog gnang ba bsgrags par gar song cha med du song*/ rgyal brgyud dang mi dpon thams cad dang pradzñā wang dma' phab 'dug pa bde bar btang*/ dbang hu brtson las bkrol/ zla ba drug tsam bzhugs/ dharma tsing wang dang ding 'ju phing chang dmag bsags 'thab dus btab nas rtsod par 'dug pa zhal tas 'khrug pa bcag /de'i skabs su slar yang gong nas lung dang gnang sbyin bskur nas mi dpon mang po spyan 'dren du sleb/ khrims dmag gis rim pas pho brang du spyan drongs gsungs pa'i lung 'dug kyang 'ja' mo tshugs gsum gyi bar la 'then gsungs/ zla ba gsum pa'i tshes gsum la sa'i char bab ltas ngan pa byung bas/ dus ngan pa shar/ gtam ngan chen po zhig myur du 'ong gsungs/ de'i nyin ti shri'i gdung sa skyar spyan 'dren pa dang*/ dbus gtsang du chos 'khor sgrub pa'i yo byad gnang sa chen rnams yar yong bas ngo log gis bcom par 'dug /lnga pa'i bcu gnyis la sa skya'i dpon chen dpal 'bum gyis zhu ba ti shri'i gdung chos 'khor 'byon gyi yod pas mdzo mchi med lnga bcu zhu zer ba sleb pas mi nyung par bzhad nas mi brdzun ma 'di tsho mtshar/ gdung chos 'khor byung na da dga' ste bcom pa'i lhag ma da phrug 'ga' zhig zhag lnga na sleb 'ong gsung ste de kho na ltar byung*/ klu chu phan chad du ma byon pas de rnams lo nyes/ gar byon gyis thams cad lo legs/ de nas gser yig pa rnams ga chur log gong du sbyor drug pa chen po tsha go shes rab dpal zer ba'i phrin las can des spyan drangs te lho phyogs yar lam khugs pa lam/ gnyan tshe de gong bshal tsha grang lcags mo brgyud te phebs/ gong du sgor mo 'dab mi btang*/ rgyal mo rong la byon/ tshugs zhe bdun gyis rab sgang du phebs/ dbra 'gru sgo lding 'khrugs pa'i dmag sogs mtha' yas pa 'dug pa rnams zhi bar mdzad de/

yig khrigs nyis brgyar nye ba mdzad/ spyir yul phyogs de'i 'khrug pa che chung dang sha 'khon thams cad lo nyi shu rtsa lnga'i bar la phul te/ thams cad bde 'jags su gyur/ zla ba dgu pa nas byi lo zla ba gnyis pa'i bar 'gor 'khrug sdum la gser srang nyis stong rta bdun brgya ja sig chen lnga brgya sogs gnang*/ rab stod du seng ge sgang btab/ yon btsun bkras rin mtshur phu'i bya 'dab lha khang gso ba la 'di dus brdzangs/ wa ga bo zhes bya ba'i ri khrod du bzhugs pa'i tshe/ byams pa mgon po dang*/ phyag na rdo rje la 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i 'khor du mas bskor ba zhal gzigs nas de dang de'i bstod pa'ang mdzad/ skabs zhig mnal lam du rdo rje 'jigs byed nam mkha'i dbyings gang bar byas nas/ bar chod rtsom mkhan gyi 'dre ngan 'dra 'dug pa rnams rdo rje'i rwa rtse la blangs te thal ba rdul du brlags nas ye med par byas yod/ do zhag yon mchod su la'ang bar chod mi 'ong par yod gsungs/ khyad par phyogs de'i mi ma yin gtum po rnams kyis dad pas zhabs la btud nas dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa mnos/ rdo rje blo gros glog gi phreng ba can dang*/ rdo rje blo gros thog gi phreng ba can sogs kyi ming btags nas srung mar bskos/ gong nas gser yig pa rnams la spyan ma 'drongs pa'i rtsa ra yong bar byung bar sgor mo 'dab mis zhus pas khrol/ slar yang gong nas/ nged la dgongs nas mdo smad du pheb 'dug kyang mi dpon rnams go ma chod pas slar bod la byon 'dug /bla ma 'dir byon nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che dar zhing rgyas par byed pa'i bya ba dang*/ rgyal khams chen po bde bar byed pa'i bya ba bzang po ji ltar byed/ nged dang mjal dus rang re yon mchod shes mod/ gal te mi 'byon na mi dpon mang po mngags te sde dgon dang mi sde mang po la gnod pa'i gzhir 'gyur ba srid pas/

sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che dang*/ nged la dgongs te mngags pa'i gser yig pa rnams kyis sleb ma thag 'byon par zhu/ zhes sogs kyi 'ja' sa gnang sbyin khyer nas/ shes rab hu shri bya ba'i mi dpon gyis mdo smad du phebs pa la/ sems can mang po la gnod kyis dogs nas/ 'jam dbyangs gu'i shris 'ja' sa gnang sbyin khyer te rab sgang du phebs/ drung nas kyang gdul bya dus la bab par mkhyen nas/ byi lo zla ba bdun pa'i bco brgyad la rab sgang nas chags bteg ste shing kun du phebs dus/ shing kun sde chen gyi mkhan po dpal ldan mchog gis thogs drangs dge 'dun stong phrag mang po dang*/ mi dpon mang po sogs dpag tu med pas 'bul ba bkur sti rgya chen po bsgrubs shing*/ rang rang gang la gang mos kyi chos dang zang zing gi sbyin pas tshim par mdzad/ go dan i jan gyi gdan sa byang ngos su sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta'i gdan sa byang ngos sprul pa sder byon 'gro ba mang po'i don mdzad/ de nas sbig the mur je shris thog drangs dben gyi mi dpon sogs kyi bkur zhing mi nyag 'ga'i rgyal khams su thams cad smin grol la bkod/ bkra shis 'phrul snang gi gtsug lag khang du sangs rgyas byang sems dpag med zhal gzigs/ rgya'i ngo log gi mi dpon che ba zhig srog bskyabs te rab byung byas/ mi sde thams cad bde bar thar/ dung ching 'ja' mor mgur cham zhig byung ba la/ ngas rmi lam zhig bzung nas nad 'di 'dra drag par bya dgos/ gnyid ma skrog gsungs/ mnal sad pa dang bsnyun pa de sangs kyis dngas 'dug / ji ltar mdzad pa lags zhus pas/ ngas po ta lar phyin/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs sku mdog dmar po phyag na bdud rtsi'i bum pa bsnams pa dang mjal/ nga la bum pa de gtad nas 'di la 'thung zhig gsungs/ 'thung pas bde gsal gyi ting nge 'dzin kyang skyes nad kyang drag gsungs/ de nas phyi lo zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i tshes bco brgyad la pho brang chen po ta'i tur pheb/

mchod rten sngon por bzhugs/ nyer gsum la mchod yon mjal/ 'di dus gong ma tho gan thi mur rgyal sar bzhugs pa'i lo nyer brgyad pa yin/ nyer drug la rgyal bu'i sras mai tri pha la 'khrungs gong ma yab sras gus pa mtha' yas/ gan che chung so so nas 'bul zhabs bkur sti gzhal gyis gar lang*/ gnam mchod thams cad kyis zla med par bkur/ rgyal po chen po la rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la sogs kyi dbang bskur zhing man ngag gi nyams khrid la nā ro chos drug lhan cig skyes sbyor/ phyag rgya chen po gang gā ma/ bsam gtan thun 'jog / sku gsum ngo sprod rnams gsungs/ rgyal bu chen po la/ yab la phul ba rnams kyi steng du/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i dbang*/ skyes rabs brgya rtsa'i bshad pa/ rgyud rtsa 'grel/ mdo sde rgyan rtsa 'grel/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo rtsa 'grel/ de'i cha lag gi rgya gzhung dang bcas pa rnams kyi bshad pa rgyas pa phul/ rgyal rgyud zhing dben thas kyi mi dpon gyis thog drangs/ rgya hor/ sog po yu gur/ mi nyag/ ka'u le sogs kyi mi chen/ sde dpon/ skya ser dpag tu med pa rnams la zab cing rgya che ba'i chos kyi char chen po phab ste/ gang la gang 'dul gyis dbang po dang 'tsham par smin grol mdzad/ nyes pa can spyi thar ba'i 'ja' sa dang*/ khyad par rgyal bu chen pos ban+dhes gong ma la phyag mi dgos par bkur ba la phyis rgyal brgyud dang*/ mi chen gyis ban+dhe'i phyag blangs 'dug /rgyal khams ma bde ba des len/ da phyis de 'dra ma byed zer ba sogs bstan pa shed skyed kyi 'ja' sa rnams gnang*/ bod tu sgrogs pa la/ sde dpon dkon mchog rgyal mtshan dang*/ chos rje pa nyid kyi dpon mgo gsum rnams btang*/ thugs byams pa chen po'i byin rlabs kyis phyi nang gi ngo log thams cad zhi/ nad yams dpag med yod pa thams cad chad/ sngon ma byung ba'i lo legs btud mar byung bas rgyal blon 'bangs dang bcas pa dam pa'i chos la yid ches shing gus pa 'phel bar gyur/
chos rje nyid kyi bka' drin las 'bri gdan tshal pa mtshur kar sogs la las ka rnying gso gsar gnang mang du byung*/ rgyal khams bde ba la bkod do//

rgyal po chen po dam pa'i chos kyi dgongs pa bzhed pa bzhin grub/ rgyal bu chen po ni mkhyen pa dang rtogs pa zla med par gyur te bstan bcos mkhas pa dgyes nus pa du ma mdzad/ than pa chen po byung ba'i tshe gong nas char 'bebs dgos pa'i lung nyi ma shar mtshams la byon pas nyi ma phyed nas char chen po bab/ skabs zhig kho bo rgyal po chen po zhig gi bur gyur te rgyan du mas brgyan cing yab dang lhan cig khang bzang gi steng du rtse ba gsal bar snang zhes gsungs pa phyis tā min rgyal po rje nyid kyi sku'i bkod pa yin 'dug pas de la dgongs pa 'dra snyam/ lo ngo gsum bzhugs pa'i rjes la/ chos rje'i gsung nas/ gong ma'i chab srid la'ang bde dog cung zad kyi rtags mtshan snang la/ rgyal po chen po'i sku tshe 'ang ring po mi bzhugs pa'i rmi ltas 'dra byung zhing*/ rang re 'dir bsdad kyang*/ dus skabs kyi stobs kyis de rnams bzlog par dka' bar 'dug pas/ nub phyogs su 'gro ba'i zhu ba nan can byed dgos par 'dug /lam du'ang gdul bya mang po zhig la skal pa dang 'tshams par phan gdags dgos pa yod ces/ gu'i gung rin chen dpal la gsungs shing*/ de dang mthun par/ gong ma yab sras kyi drung du/ zhu ba yang dang yang du phul na'ang gong ma yab sras kyis ma gnang zhing zhu ba drag tu phul ba'i dus zhig /rgyal bu chen pos spyan chab bton nas/ bla ma cis kyang bzhugs par thugs rjes 'dzin par zhu zhes sogs gsungs/ yang la'o jang ching sang dang zhing ra mun ching sar bya ba'i mi dpon chen po gnyis kyis chos rje'i drung du phyag 'tshal pus mo btsugs te/ bla ma la zhu na/ sngar sman tse nas kyi 'dab sgo rnams lo dgu la chad/ de stobs kyis dngul bre chen re la 'bru 'jag lnga las med pa la/ bla ma khyed byon nas nad yams rnams chad/ rgyal bu chen po la sras 'khrungs/ phyi nang gi ngo log brtsams pa rnams kyang rang sar zhi nas 'dab sgo rnams phyogs phyogs nas sleb/

da zhag dngul bre chen la'ang 'jag brgyad cu mar song 'dug /gong ma yab sras kyang spyan chab bton nas bzhugs pa'i zhu ba byed cing 'dug pa/ skye bo phal gyis kyang 'bru 'phel zhing bkra shis pa'i bla ma zhes mtshan gsol ba'i skabs 'dir/ de tsam zhu ba nan can mdzad nas bod du ci mdzad du 'byon pa yin/ sngar bla ma 'phags pa dang se cher rgyal po yon mchod bzhin du/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che'i dar rgyas dang*/ rgyal khams kyi bya ba rnams khyed rang yon mchod kyis mdzad pa mi 'thad dam/ thugs dgongs legs por thong mdzod/ ces zhus pa'i lan du/ khrom che ba'i skabs su rtsed mo de 'phror bzhag na ngo mtshar che ba yin/ nged la gong ma yab sras kyi sku'i rim gror/ dkon mchog gsum la gsol ba 'debs pa ma gtogs pa rgyal khams kyi bya ba la kha gtogs pa'i/ lung dang ling ji dang dgos ched dang shes sgo gang yang med/ ban de bya ba de gang skyid par 'gro zhing bstan pa dang sems can la gang phan byed dgos pa yin/ yul gang la'ang ma zhen ma chags pa zhig byung na chos pa bzang ba yin/ ces sogs gsungs bas/ mi dpon de gnyis kyis de ma thag tu gsung de rnams yu gur gi yi ges 'debs shing 'dug /de ltar gal gy-is gcus te zhu ba nan can mdzad pas/ re zhig nub phyogs su 'byon pa'i lung dang ling ji gnang sbyin 'u lag rnams gnang*/ yang skabs der gong ma la zhus te/ bla ma 'phags pa'i gdan sa bar pa shing kun sde chen gyi mkhan po dpal ldan mchog la/ gu'i shrī ming dang shel gyi tham kha zhus nas gnang*/ stag lo zla ba dang po'i bcu bzhi la bteg /dung tshang du bla chen bsod blo dang zhal 'dzom/ nag can mang po chad pa las bskyabs/ lam du hwo ya zi'i rgyal khams gyi 'khrug chen bcag /lu pan shan du rgyal bu dang btsun mo pu ṇ+ye dha rī dang bcas pa smin par mdzad/ mi nyag gi yul tha thal la brgyud de byang ngos su phebs/

go ra dgon mo cher gtsug lag khang chen po bzhengs shing bstan pa dar rgyas su mdzad pa'i tshe/ sku'i bkod pa gzigs te/ rang gzhan gyi don 'grub pa'i khyad par gsal bar byed pa'i bstod pa mdzad/ yang skabs zhig spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug zhal gzigs nas de'i bstod pa mdzad/ go ra'i ri khrod shal stengs su bzhugs pa'i dus zla ba gnyis tshun chad kyi lam phyogs phyogs nas mjal mkhan khri phrag mang po rgyun ring du byung ba la/ la las ni pha ma rgan gog rnga mong la bkal nas byung*/ phal cher rnams kyis dad mos kyis gom phyag ches pa'i gom pa bdun bdun bor nas phyag gsum gsum/ chos rje bzhugs pa'i phyogs su 'tshal zhing 'ongs pa rnams la chos dang zang zing gis tshim par mdzad do/ /yang de nyid du 'jam dbyangs zhal gzigs te de'i bstod pa mdzad do// yang dus cig gi tshe/ mi dkar po zhig gis ral gri ngar ma dang bdar mang po byin pa'i snang ba byung*/ de phyin chad nas lha'i bstod pa sogs tshigs bcad rtsom pa la bsam mno btang mi dgos par 'dug gsungs/ de nas kang ju zhing gi mkhar dang nye ba'i sa/ ma gya si zhes pa'i sder bzhuḍa pa'i dus yu gur gyi yul dang*/ mi nyag gi yul dang*/ kam log gi yul dang*/ hor yul la sogs phyogs phyogs nas zla lam tshun nas dad 'dun ldan pa'i skye bo rnams gom phyag sogs kyis mjal du 'ongs pa la/ chos rje'i drung nas thugs dam gyi khrig dang tsha dro gsol ba ma gtogs/ rang rang gang mos kyi chos dang zang zing gi sbyin pa sogs bsdu ba rnams pa bzhis tshim par mdzad cing nyin bzhin byin rlabs bshar nas/ byin rlabs thob ste bskyar du med pa'i khrim bcas nas rim gyis 'grim pa la/ zhag dgu bcu na re zhig rdzogs pa tsam byung ngo*/ /de dus stod hor gyi rgyal po thu mug the mur gyis/ nged kyi bla mchod la lan cig cis kyang 'byon par zhu zhes pa'i lung lag rtags gnang sbyin rgya chen po byung na'ang ma bzhud do//

yang kong ju'i zhing du nad yams chen po byung ste/ ma gya si'i sde phyogs su yang byung gis dogs nas thams cad skrag par gyur pa la/ slob dpon chen po gu'i gung pas 'di lta bu'i nad yams chen po la phan par bya ba'i thabs 'dra mchis lags sam zhes zhus pas/ drung gi zhal nas thabs bya yis gnyid ma skrog cig ces gsung zhing*/ mnal ba'i tshul mdzad de/ slob dpon chen po sku mdun du bzhugs pa las gzim khang gi steng du tsheg cham gyi sgra chen po tshad med pa byung*/ ci zhig ltar la drung nyid ting nge 'dzin las bzhengs te/ khang steng 'dir ltas kyi rnam pa 'dra byung ngam gsungs/ byung tshul zhus pas/ nad yams 'di phyogs su mi 'ong la sngar yod pa rnams kyang myur du rgyun chad par yod ces gsungs/ de ji ltar lags zhus pas/ nad bdag mi ma yin zang zing mang po 'dug pa la kho bos kang ju'i zhing thams cad gshog pas khebs pa'i khyung chen po zhig tu byas nas/ gdon mi ma yin de rnams rdo rje'i mchus bcom zhing zos te khang du ye shes kyi me 'bar bas rab tu bsregs nas cung zad tsam yang med par byas shing*/ khang thog 'dir bab pa yin/ sems kyi sprul bsgyur la yang phyi rol du tsheg sgra la sogs rtags mtshan gsal bar 'ong ba 'di mtshar bar gda' ang*/ 'di lta bu gzhan la bshad par mi bya'o/ /zhes gsungs te/ ji skad gsung ba de kho na ltar gyur to// de nas kang ju'i du ma sde la byon te bzhugs pa'i tshe/ sku khams cung zad ma bde bar gyur pa la thugs dam ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ dpal u rgyan gyi gnas su byon/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje rnal 'byor ma 'khor rigs bzhi'i mkha' 'gro ma rgya mtsho grangs med pas bskor ba'i zhal gzigs/ gtso mo'i phyag gi ka pā la ye shes kyi bdud rtsi 'o ma ltar dkar zhing ro mchog brgya dang ldan pas gang pa gnang ste gsol bas/ sku zag pa med pa'i bde ba chen pos yongs su gang bar gyur te/

de'i tshe phyag rgya bzhi ldan rdo rje'i mgur gsungs/ yang kang ju'i 'jam dbyangs sder bzhugs pa'i tshe/ snyan ngag me long gsan pa'i dgongs pa shar ba las/ de'i mtshan mo tho rangs kha dbyangs can ma mi'i bu mo mchog tu mdzes pa'i gzugs su sprul te/ zho bum pa gang byin nas 'di gsol dang snyan ngag me long la sogs snyan ngag ma lus pa mkhyen par 'gyur ro/ /zhes lung ston pa gzigs te/ phyir nang snyan ngag me long le'u gnyis kyi tshig don ma lus pa thogs pa med par mngon sum du gyur pa'i tshul mdzad/ yang go ra dgon mo cher bzhugs pa'i dus zhig gi tshe/ 'brum pa'i nad kyis nye bar 'tshe ba chen po byung zhing*/ byur dogs pa'i sdug bsngal gyis gzir ba la/ drung gi zhal nas/ kho bos rmi lam du byang ngos thams cad khebs pa'i khyung chen po zhig tu byas nas/ nad bdag mi ma yin gyi tshogs rnams gshog lcag gi brdabs shing gtor bas cung zad tsam yang med par byas te/ da 'dir 'brum pa mi 'ong zhing gzhan du byung ba rnams kyang chad par 'gyur zhes gsungs pa de kho na ltar gyur/ de nas be ri lha sdong gis gdan drangs te zhag bzhi bcu'i bar du 'gro don mdzad/ der rta stong phrag lnga dang bdun brgya gnag phyugs gser dngul gos dar sogs bsam gyis mi khyab par byung ba rnams dbus gtsang gi dgon sde btsun pa bcu yod pa yan chad du/ mang ja bdun bdun 'bul ba rnam bzhag dang bcas pa sgrub pa la/ bla ma ri bo sgang pa btang zhing*/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che la phu dud du mdzad de/ spyir yang byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i smon lam gyi sprin rgya chen po dang rjes su mthun par/ rgya bod kyi gtsug lag khang rnams na bzhugs pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi rten rnams la mchod pa dang*/ bkur sti phun sum tshogs pa mdzad de/ de yang*/ jo bo rin po che'i drung du dngul bre bcu gcig las brdungs pa'i kong bu/

gdan sa chen po mtshur phur lha chen 'dzam gling rgyan gyi sku la gser bre chen lnga la brdungs pa'i gser shog dang*/ dngul bre sum cu rtsa gcig la brdungs pa'i kong bu lnga/ jo gdan dge 'dun sgang pa la dngul bre gsum gyi kong bu/ bde chen du dngul bre gsum gyi kong bu/ dpal ldan karma'i gdan sar kong bu bdun/ ske rags brags rtsar rang byon sgrol ma'i drung du kong bu/ byang ngos su 'phags pa shel byon gyi drung du dngul bre phyed dang gsum gyi kong bu la kong rgyags dngul bre bcu/ kang ju'i 'phags pa glo nyal gyi drung du dngul bre gsum gyi kong bu la kong rgyags dngul bre brgyad/ ka kyog byams pa'i drung du kong bu/ shing khang byams pa'i drung du kong bu/ 'phags pa bye ma'i drung du kong bu/ zha jur byams chen gnyis kyi drung du kong bu re/ 'jam dbyangs lha khang gnyis kyi drung du kong bu re re/ 'phags pa se lam gi drung du kong bu ste/ de rnams su mar me rgyun 'bar btsugs nas skye bo rnams kyi tshogs gnyis mngon par 'phel ba'i thabs rgya chen po drung gi dgongs pa ji lta bar/ slob dpon chen pos phyag len la thems par mdzad do// de nas btsang kha'i yul du byon te ra khri phag ching waṃ/ rdo rje dpal phin chang zi na/ mar tshang*/ mal shing sogs rnams kyis bsnyen bkur bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnos shing*/ chos dang zang zing gi gnang sbyin rgya chen pos/ 'di dang phyi ma'i dbul ba dang rgud pa mtha' dag las bskyab par mdzad de/ lha mo lung dang seng sman rtser bzhugs te/ gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i don bsdus mdzad/ btsong kha mtsho sngon gyi 'gram du lta ba ngan sel gyi bstan bcos kyang mdzad/ dpa' blo bzang grags pa rten gzhon nur yod pas rab byung zhus pa na dge bsnyen du bsgrubs te mtshan kun dga' snying por gsol/ /skyes bu dam pa yin par lung bstan te/
