phyis sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la ston pa gnyis pa'i phrin las mdzad pa 'di byung*/ da dung yul phyogs der bzhugs par kun gyis zhus kyang ma gnang par/ yul khams 'dir ri dwags sdod pa zhig myur por 'ong par 'dug ces nye 'khor du gnas pa la gsang tshig du gsungs so// de nas nang 'khrugs dang*/ phyi nas kyang dmag sde lhags te gsungs pa ltar gyur/ de nas byang ngos sprul pa sde'i lung du bru gun zhes bod skad du mar khu'i gzhong pa zhes bya ba rang bzhin gyi nyams dga' ba'i sa phyogs spang thang dang*/ brag ri dang*/ ljon shing la sogs pa'i mdzes pa du mas brgyan pa dpal mtsho bkra zhes bya bar/ dben gnas btab ste bzhugs/ gdul bya dpag med smin grol la bkod/ de dus phal cher lung pa thams cad 'ja' 'od kyis 'khrigs shing bde bar gshegs pa nam mkha'i skar ma tsam zhal gzigs pa'i tshe/ bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs rje la mngon par bskul ba'i bstod pa dang*/ 'od dpag med zhal gzigs nas de'i 'od zer la bstod pa dang*/ kun tu bzang po zhal gzigs nas de la bstod pa dang*/ khro bo'i rgyal po mi g.yo ba zhal gzigs nas de la bstod pa dang*/ sngon dang phyi ma'i mtha' mang po dang*/ las dge sdig gi 'bras bu bde sdug mang po mngon du dran nas/ bsod nams la spro ba skyed pa'i gtam dang*/ gzhan yang nyams rtogs khyad par can 'khrungs nas zab don gyi mgur ma yang mdzad/ de skabs zhig tu mgul cham thu mo zhig byung ba la/ gu'i gung pa la/ khyod kyis gnyid ma skrog cig /ngas rmi lam thun cig bzung la cham pa 'di sel par byed pa yin gsungs/ mnal sad pa dang*/ bsnyun de sangs kyis dngas 'dug pa dang*/ de'i bar la bsnyun de dngas 'dug pa/ /yi dam lha'i zhal gzigs 'dra ba byung lags sam zhes zhus pas/ de ltar byung*/ nged kyis po ta lar phyin de'i zhing khams thams cad rin po che 'ba' zhig las grub par 'dug gzhal yas khang gi dbus su spyan ras gzigs la/

byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pa dang*/ sgrol ma la sogs pa lha mo dpag tu med pas bskor nas 'dug /'phags pa'i phyag na bum pa zhig bsnams 'dug pa la 'thung zhig gsungs/ ngas de la mchu gtad de 'thungs pa dang*/ 'o ma 'dra ba'i dkar po zhim po zhig yun ring du 'thung pa snyam byed/ de'i gzhal med bkod pa'i bye brag rnams/ skye bo phal pas lo mang por bgrang bar nges par mi nus pa tsam du 'dug mod/ rmi lam gyi snang ba la ni de'i bar la/ thams cad so sor nges par shar 'dug la nad kyang sangs kyis drag 'dug gsungs/ skabs zhig nam mkhar 'ja' 'od kha dog dang*/ dbyibs sna tshogs pa dang*/ me tog gi char bab pas drung gi zhal nas kho bo la'ang dag snang mang du byung zhing*/ mtshan ltas khyad par can 'di dag rgyal ba g.yung zhing khams gzhan du gshegs pa'i ltas min nam zhes gsungs zhing*/ de'i tshe sngon dang phyi ma'i skyes rabs mang po dang*/ bsod nams dang bsod nams ma yin pa'i 'bras bu rnams dag pa bkra ba'i tshul du/ bye ba du ma dag yang dag par gzigs te/ bsod nams la spro ba skyed pa zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos snyan ngag sdeb sbyor thams cad kyi snying por gyur pa mdzad de/ ji ltar gsungs pa bzhin/ rgyal ba g.yung zhi bar gshegs pa dang dus mtshungs par gyur/ de nas yul skyong khri skor dang be ri rgya gling gis gdan drangs te/ dpel mdo dang*/ so 'jam kha gsum dang khri khar byon/ gser dngul gos dar/ rta phyugs brgya stong khri 'bul byas shing gces phrug mang po rab tu byung*/ gang la gang 'dul gyi chos zab cing rgya che ba bsten nas 'gro ba dpag tu med pa la thar pa'i sa bon zhogs par mdzad do//

de dus dbang rgyal dben shris dmag khri phrag tsam khyer nas/ yul skyong khri bskor be ri rgya gling 'debs su byung ba la/ zhal nas bzlog go /de'i skabs zhig tu bcom ldan 'das rgyal ba shākya thub pa la byang chub sems dpa' nye ba'i sras brgyad kyis bskor ba zhal gzigs nas de'i bstod pa yang mdzad/ yang mtsho bkra'i gnas su/ skabs zhig dpon mo puṇ+ye dha rī mjal du byung nas kho mo'i rmi lam du/ ba dan yang dben gyi ri 'di dang mnyam pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sku zhig bzhengs dang 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /zhes pa zhig byung lags shing*/ rgyal bu chen po rat+na'i thugs dgongs rdzogs pa'i phyir de cis kyang bzhengs bsam pa yod lags pas/ de 'grub pa'i thabs mkhas thugs rje drung nas mkhyen ces zhu gin gda'/ de la gzhan thams cad ha las nas mig rig rig por lta zhing mi 'grub ces pa'i brda' bstan kyang*/ chos rje'i drung nas zhal 'dzum pa dang bcas te thabs yod kyis gos dar la/ sangs rgyas kyi sku'i 'phan chen po zhig bzhengs par mdzod cig gsungs/ der dpon mos/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen/ mi dpon dang*/ bzo rig pa rnams bsdus te 'di lta bu bsgrub par bya'o zhes bsgo ba na/ rgya nag gi bzo rig pa shes rab che yang*/ de 'dra'i bkod pa blo yul du chud pa su yang ma byung nas/ yang chos rje'i drung du de ji ltar bgyi zhus pas/ de ka rang la gzhi byes thams cad kyi sa chu rdo dkar po khu tshur tsam mang po khyer la thang pha kir shog gsungs/ de ltar bgyis pa na ri logs 'jam po la rdo ba rnams sgrig tu bcug ste/ gsung rgyun la drung nyid chibs pa bcib nas pheb ste rta'i rmig rjes gang byung du rdo ba re zhog gsungs nas de ltar byas zhes zer/ chags tshad de dang bstun te dpon mos bzo bo lnga brgya tsam la gos dar gtad nas/ sku sha hor gos nog na gyis gser mdog tu byas shing na bza' tahuṃ gis dmar po sogs gos bzang bsgrig pa 'ba' zhig gis/

gtso bo bcom ldan 'das snyan g.yas g.yon gyi bar du 'dom bcu gcig yod pa tshad des mtshon pa'i sku yongs rdzogs skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ g.yas g.yon du 'jam dpal dang*/ byams pa gnyis bzhengs pa/ steng nas lhas mchod cing 'og tu pad gdan gyis mdzes pa thang sku ltar gong sham dang bcas shing sham bu byi'u phrug kha can/ rgyu tshad bkod pa phun sum tshogs pa zla ba bcu gsum gyis bsgrubs zin ri logs de nyid du bkram zhing*/ chos rje'i drung nas rab gnas mdzad pa'i tshe/ 'ja' dang 'od dang sa g.yo ba dang*/ me tog gi char chen po 'bab pa sogs ltas cho 'phrul bzang po ngo mtshar ba yang byung ba skye bo mang po'i mthun snang du grub ste/ de nas 'phan chen de nyid kyang chos rje'i drung du phul ba/ bod du gdan drangs pa'i khal ma ni mdzo bzhi bcu zhe bzhi bsor nas nyi shu rtsa gnyis re'i rgyab non pa yod par snang ste/ ldem gnyis 'bri gdan gnyis la so sor gnang*/ sku dngos zho khar bzhugs pa phyis sku stod kyi dos lnga tsam ma tshang nas/ rje chos grags rgya mtshos rtse lha sgang du gso ba mdzad de sku stod rtse lha sgang dang gzhan zho kha na bzhugs la/ rten 'brel 'dis bar du/ kaṃ tshang gi bstan pa'i sel cung zad byung ba yin pas/ da dung phyogs gcig tu bzhugs pa gal che bar yod do// spyir sku 'di lha sar bzhugs na rten 'brel shin tu legs snyam zhes gtsug lag phreng ba gsungs/ 'on kyang dus phyis o rod kyi sog dmag lhags shing kar bstan 'pho 'gyur gyi skabs su/ 'phan chen dum bur gtubs nas khyer ba 'dra ste/ de'i dum bu yin nam snyam pa 'ba' zhig kho bos kyang mig lam du bstar ro/ /de nas zha ju tong tshan du mjal ba la byon pa'i zha ju phyogs kyi mdun ngos nas 'ja' kha dog lnga pa nyin bzhin dkrigs pa sogs ngo mtshar ba'i ltas/ khyad du 'phags pa kun gyis mthong ngo*/ /gnas der byams pa'i sku'i zhabs kyi rting pa gad pa la nub pa'i bol gong la mi tshad ma'i 'dom bzhi yod pa'i/

lha khang rgya phibs bya 'dab bdun pa zhig dang*/ yang byams chen gyi lha khang bya 'dab lnga pa zhig gis thog drangs/ lha khang sum stong bdun brgya yod pa la/ la la ni sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i sprul pas bzhengs pa'i lha khang*/ la la ni rgya nag dang*/ hor gyi rgyal pos bzhengs/ nged bod kyi rgyal po mnga' bdag khri ral gyis bzhengs pa'i lha khang yang 'dug /de rnams kyi nye 'khor sa phyogs su dbang gi khrims sar gsum gyis mgo byas mi dpon che chung dang*/ yu gur mi nyag sogs kyi sde dpon/ ban de mi sde/ dmag ban skya rnams kyis gser dngul gos dar rta dang rnga mong sogs/ brgya 'bul stong 'bul byung ba'i phyag rdzas dpag med byung ba rnams byams chen gnyis dang*/ 'jam dbyangs byin rlabs can gyi lha khang gnyis dang*/ 'phags pa se lig /'phags pa bye ma rnams kyi drung du rgyun 'bar btsugs pa'i chas la 'bul/ der bcom ldan 'das 'jam pa'i dbyangs zhal gzigs nas bstod pa'ang mdzad/ de nas kan ci'u la tshur pheb ste/ du ma sha hi'i sde'i ri bo la bzhugs pa'i tshe/ 'jam dbyangs zhal gzigs nas bstod pa mdzad/ de nas dpon mo puṇ+ye dha rīs lu phan shan du gdan drangs pa'i tshe/ li tsi tsi'i dmag nye 'khor du sleb ces thos pas thams cad skrag par gyur cing*/ de dang rjes su mthun pa'i zhu ba phul ba'i tshe/ drung gi zhal nas/ nged kyis su la'ang bsam sbyor gang gi sgo nas gnod 'tshe ma myong ba'i phyir/ phyogs bcu nas dmag lhags par gyur kyang 'bros mi dgos la/ khyad par du da lan dmag gi 'jigs pa mi 'byung pas skrag mi 'tshal/ zhes gsungs pa bzhin du rgya dmag rnams kyang log nas yul phyogs bkra shis par gyur/ phyogs der stag gi 'jigs pa che yang ri rtse der dbyar zhugs zla ba gsum mdzad pa'i ring la/ gang 'dod 'dod du gnod pa med par 'grim 'grul byas chog pa byung*/ dbyar zhugs grol ba dang*/

dpon mos lu pan shan gyi lha khang gi thog mo gyo thams cad zangs la pho gyo thams cad dkar yol las byas pa/ 'og gzhi thams cad shel lta bu'i rdo las byas pa'i dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi lha khang gi sde khyad du 'phags pa de'i zhabs tog mar me'i chas kyi sa zhing 'jag nyis stong gi sa dang chu bskor/ mi sde dud ka brgya dang bcu bdun/ gser dngul gos dar/ rta khyu/ rin po che'i rigs la sogs dpag tu med pa phul/ de nas bod du byang lam nas byon pa la/ lam rgyus shes pa gzhan ni ye ma byung bas thams cad sems las che ba'i skabs su/ mdo stod du 'gro ba'i lam 'di 'dra byas na bde gsungs nas/ byang rma zla bya ba'i gangs gseb la zhag mang po'i bar du phyin pas/ nor 'chug med par 'dan du phyags phebs/ de nas si tu dang*/ dge slong yon tan dpal gyis thog drangs/ dge 'dun mang po bsu ba la phebs/ 'dan stod la byon/ ske rags brag rtsa'i rang byon sgrol ma la mjal rgyun 'bar btsugs/ de nas karma lha steng du phebs te chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ lha steng du bzhugs pa'i tshe/ gling byang bzang du dben sha'i bu gzhon nu zhig yod pa de'i rmi lam du/ thog mar chos rje dang mjal/ de nas chos rje ba spyan ras gzigs dkar la 'od zer 'phro ba zhig tu gyur pa'i/ mdun du kho rang 'dug pa rmis/ gnyid sad pa dang nam skya sang gis langs 'dug de'i gro kha/ chos rje'i drung du kho rab tu byung bar 'dug /des chos drug ma zhus kyi gong nas rmi lam cung zad zin cing sprul bsgyur yang cung zad nus pa zhig yin zer/ karma dgon du nā ro chos drug la sogs pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po bskor/ kun tu bzang po bzhi sbyor gyi man ngag yi ger mdzad/ de nas rim gyis sgom sde pa sogs kyi lha sde mi sde rnams kyis mjal zhing*/ so so nas 'bul ba zhabs tog byas shing*/ dbang po dang 'tsham pa'i chos kyis tshim par mdzad/

lho stod du phebs tre bo du dben shal gyis skyel bsu zhabs tog dang*/ khyad par du dgon sa phul te/ rong po khyung po/ dkar shod nag shod/ brgyad shog sogs stod smad/ kong po tshun gyi ban skya dpag med 'tshogs pa rnams la gang la gang 'os kyi chos dang zang zing gis tshim par mdzad/ sngon rang byung zhabs kyis/ lar thams cad 'du ba'i gnas zhig yod/ /ces lung bstan pa dang mthun par re rgyab tu nyi phug steng chen zhes pa'i dgon btab lha khang bzhengs/ dge 'dun mang pos ma ṇi'i bum sgrub btsugs/ dge 'dun pa nyis stong tsam 'tshogs pa byung ngo*/ /der rang bzhin rnam par dag pa'i dbyings/ zhes sogs kyi mgur bzhengs/ yor rgyangs gangs kyi ri bo dang nye ba'i brag dkar seng ge gnam rdzong du byon pa'i tshe/ dam pa dang po'i nges gsang gi mgur mdzad/ dbyar de sha ta la byon te/ rmug ri gzhung zhes pa'i ri zhol du/ dngul yig pa a 'tsho dge bshes/ ga brang bla ma sogs dad ldan gyi bu slob mang du 'dus shing*/ chos dang zang zing gi dpal 'byor la longs spyod pa'i tshe/ phrag dog gi ling tog gis dad gus kyi mig bkab nas ngan sems kyi mchi ma drag tu 'bab pa'i mi ngan 'ga' zhig gis/ brnab sems dang gnod sems dang*/ log ltas kun nas blangs te/ 'dre ngan bsgrub pa la mi tshe stong zad du bskyal ba'i ngan rtags su thog dang ser ba drag tu 'bebs shing*/ gzhan la 'tshe ba kho na byed pa la myogs nas thog ser 'bebs pa'i cho ga la zhugs shing*/ yon bdag rnams la kha tsho mang du bton yod par snang ba'i tshe/ kho rang rnams yod sar char rmugs dang 'brug sgra cher grag cing*/ chos rje'i sgar du nyi ma shar/ 'ja' dang 'od 'khyil zhing bkra shis pa'i mtshan ltas mang du byung bas thams cad ngo mtshar du gyur/ slar re rgyab tu pheb ste dgun bzhugs dang dbyar bzhugs gnyis ka mdzad/ zla ba brgyad pa tsam la shag la byon/ 'bri gung si tu ye shes rgyal mtshan pa sku 'khor rnams dang mjal nas chos kyi sbyin pa rgya chen po mdzad cing*/

khyad par du si tu pa la nges 'byung gi thugs dgongs rnam par dag pa 'khrungs te/ khri skor gyi dpal 'byor mchil ma'i thal ba bzhin du dor nas/ bla na med pa'i byang chub bsgrub pa la tshul bzhin du zhugs par gyur to// de nas yang re rgyab tu byon te bzhugs pa'i dus/ gong mo'i lung*/ gnang sbyin zhal lung dang bcas pa gdan drangs nas/ bhi ma la gu shri sogs mi dpon mang po'i gdan 'dren pa byung ba rnams dbus gtsang la btang*/ drung nas nyi phug steng chen du bzhugs pa mgul cham zhig bsnyun pa'i dus rnal lam du po ṭa lar spyan ras gzigs sku mdog sngon po zhig gis bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis dbang bskur ba byung bas bsnyun las grol/ de nas rim gyis gser g.yu rta rna dgon/ karma re ni dgon rnams su byon nas/ re ne'i dus gsum mkhyen pa'i sku 'bum byin rlabs can gyi zhabs tog kyang cung zad mdzad/ de nas ri bo che'i dgon par gdan drangs te/ ri bo che pas gtso mdzad dge 'dun rnams kyis zhabs spyi bor blangs/ chos zhus 'bul ba zhabs tog bsam gyis mi khyab pa mdzad do// de nas tsha ba sgang*/ ka na brag /to ma par rnams su byon te 'gro don rgya chen po mdzad/ ka na dang rdo rje del dkar gnyis su ma ṇi'i bum bsgrub re btsugs/ de nas smar khams le smad la byon/ drung dbon pa/ spang 'od zer bla ma/ shar kha'i bla ma dpal ldan pa sogs/ bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen dge 'dun/ skye bo'i tshogs dang bcas pa khri phrag mang po 'dus shing 'bul nod rgya chen po bsgrubs pa la/ so so'i thugs bzhed dang mthun pa ltar chos dang zang zing gi sbyin pa rgya chen pos tshim par mdzad/ khyad par du spang 'od zer bla mas lo du mar dge 'dun mang pos bsgrubs shing ngo mtshar ba'i bsgrub ltas can ma ṇi'i bum bsgrub rnams phul nas/ 'di rnams kyi bdag po gzhan gyis mi 'ongs pas/ drung nas mdzad par zhu zhes gsol ba btab/

de bskor du 'bul nod byung ba'i phyag rdzas thams cad/ bum bsgrub kyi rten du phul/ de nas pha ra dgon/ 'ba' thang*/ spung ri rnams su byon nas/ bla ma/ dge 'dun/ mi dpon/ skye bo'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyis 'bul ba/ bsnyen bkur bsu skyel dpag tu med par byas shing*/ khyad par du sa dmar stong dpon gyis/ glang mdo'i sde lha khang*/ zhing gzhis dbon po dang bcas pa phul/ de nas kaṃ po gnas nang*/ shar kol ti/ se rog dgon/ kheng sel mdo/ yon po/ yang steng*/ spang phug rnams su byon/ 'gro don dang 'bul zhabs sogs mtha' yas/ kol ti lha khang gi mar me la gnang*/ gzhan phal cher ma ṇi'i yon la gnang*/ spang phug du dbyar bzhugs mdzad pa'i skabs zhig 'jam dbyangs zhal gzigs te bstod pa'ang mdzad/ de nas la stod dgon dang*/ phar phyi la byon pa'i 'bul ba phal cher/ spang phug gi mar me dang zhig gsos la bzhag /de nas le thang dang khrom gyi spyi thog rnams su byon pa'i tshe 'bul ba dang zhabs tog mtha' yas shing 'gro don dpag med mdzad/ de nas 'bom che chung gi dgon pa phal che bar byon/ be leb tu dgon pa gsar pa 'debs pa'i sa gzhi la rab gnas mdzad/ dgon gsar kyi ming rin chen gling du btags/ dgon rkyen dang phyag rdzas mang du bzhag /rong btsan kha ba dkar po gzigs pa'i phyir ri ltas la byon par kun gyis mthun snang du grub par 'ja'i gur phub 'od dkar po phyogs bzhir 'phro ba byung*/ 'bo de dgon du drung nas chos khri khar bzhugs pa'i tshe/ rong btsan kha ba dkar po'i ril lo bcu gnyis bsgom pa'i sgoms chen zhig gis 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi skur mthong*/ des gzhan la bstan yang ma mthong ba byung*/ der 'bom mtsho phyug mo la gzigs su byon te mtsho 'gram du bzhugs pa'i tshe/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs zhal gzigs shing*/ sku 'khor rnams kyis kyang 'ja'i phung po chen po 'od zer 'phro ba mthong ba la/

drung gi zhal nas 'ja' 'od mthong ba'ang dga' mo yin gsungs shing 'jam dbyangs kyi bstod pa'ang mdzad/ de nas tshur shal 'gu/ rab sgang*/ dar rtse mdo bar du byon 'bul ba zhabs tog phun sum tshogs pa dang*/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen mang po la rang rang gi thugs bzhed dang mthun pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar mdzad do/ /dar rtse mdor ja'i 'bul ba mang po byung ba rnams rab sgang gi dge bshes rnams la gnang*/ yar lan 'bom nyag thang du byon pa'i tshe lha mi kun gyis bkur sti 'bul nod chen po byas shing*/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che nyi ma shar ba ltar gsal ba'i tshe/ bdud dang mu stegs byed kyi dpung gnyen 'ga' zhig phrag dog gis rgyud dkrugs te/ sgar nang du ser rta bskyal zhing*/ mgo 'khor du re ba'i blun po rnams kyi mdun du kha po bton cing bsam ngan sbyor rtsub la zhugs pa na ma rabs rnams yod sar/ ser ba co ga'i sgong nga tsam nyi ma phyed skad cig la bab po/ sgar gyi mthar yang re zung byung ba la/ chos rje'i drung nas gzigs stangs dang*/ phyag mdzub gtad tsam gyis slar log par gyur/ 'bom nyag gi rgyab tu drung nas chos khri'i khar bzhugs pa de/ nyag rong ba ye shes dpal gyis ye shes mgon po phyag drug pa gzi brjid dang ldan pa zhig tu mthong*/ rtsa na yod pa'i grogs po rnams la bstan yang ma mthong nas/ khyed rnams la mig med pa 'dra zer zhing gad mo dgod kyin gda'/ de nas tre'i yul la byon/ khu do ras pa'i lha khang gi rab gnas mdzad/ thang brgyad re 'jam dbu 'jam la byon/ dad ldan gyi gdul bya khri phrag mang po rim pa ltar 'tshogs/ chos dang zang zing sbyin pas tshim par mdzad/ rgya nag nas na bza' dang gos dar mang po bskur nas gdan 'dren dbu 'jam du sleb ste zhal gyis ma bzhes/ de nas sga stod la byon/ a gnyan dam pa'i dbon po dang*/ bla ma dge 'dun skye bo'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyang chos kyi spyin pas tshim par mdzad de/
phun sum tshogs pa'i 'bul ba zhabs tog byas so//

de nas ske rags brag rtsar rang byon sgrol ma mjal du byon/ 'phags ma sgrol ma sangs rgyas byang sems sprin gyi phung po lta bu'i dbus na bzhugs pa zhal gzigs nas bstod pa yang mdzad/ de nas byon te re rgyab nyi phug steng chen du pheb nas bzhugs pa'i dus re zhig gi tshe/ mgul cham thu mo zhig bsnyun pa la/ chos rje'i zhal nas khyed rnams kyis gnyid ma skrog ngas rmi lam zhig bzung nas nad 'di phan par bya'o gsungs nas gzims/ mnal sad ma thag bsnyun yang dngas 'dug pas/ gu'i gung pas/ de bar la bsnyun dngas gda' ba ji ltar mdzad pa lags zhus pas/ ngas khyung zhig tu byas nas bar gcod rtsom pa'i gdon phran 'dra 'dug pa rnams gshog lcag gis bdas pas/ ba dan ri rtse'i ri 'di yang na bun chung ngu rlung gis ded pa 'dra bar song snyam pa zhig byung tsam na/ nad de yang drag 'dug gsungs/ yang gnas de nyid du/ bcom ldan 'das thub pa'i dbang po/ rgyal sras nam mkha'i snying po dang*/ lha mo dbyangs can ma 'khor dang bcas pa rnams skabs skabs su zhal gzigs te/ de dang de'i bstod pa yang mdzad/ gnas der rnam rig dbu ma'i don ji lta bar thugs la shar nas theg bsdus kyi sa bcad mdzad/ yang dus gcig gi tshe/ mgul cham bsnyun pa sogs gong dang 'dra ba la ji ltar mdzad zhus pas/ chos rje'i zhal nas/ nged po ta lar phyin 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang sku mdog sngon po/ sangs rgyas byang sems sprin gyi phung phung po lta bu'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ phyag na bum pa bsnams pa zhig dang mjal/ 'di la 'thungs shig gsungs nas bum pa la mchu gtad de 'thungs pas zhim po gcig gis kha ngoms pa 'dra ba zhig byung gnyid sad pa dang nad kyang drag 'dug gsungs/ der kong po sogs kyi gdan 'dren pa mang du slebs pa dang*/ 'phan chen kar ma na bzhugs pa gdan drangs nas re rgyab tu bzhugs/ drung nas rdza dgon la byon/ nang pa rin rgyal sogs rong po'i dgon pa mi sde dang gung ru grags dbang sogs kyis gdan drangs dpal 'bar du byon/

gu'i shri pas gtso mdzad/ mtshur phu'i gdan 'dren pa rnams kyang der phebs so// de nas rngod la byon nas 'phan chen gdan 'dren pa la btang*/ a la la byon/ kong po brag gsum phur phebs/ nags phu dang zho kha rnams su byon/ 'phan chen zho kha lha khang du bzhugs su bcug /de nas kong ral gsum gyi nyong kong la byon/ brag phyir yon bdag 'dzom dar gyis rta brgya 'bul byas/ 'o thang du yon bdag sngon pos rta'i brgya 'bul byas/ lta bar rgyal 'dzing du yon bdag blo bdes rta'i brgya 'bul dang ston mo chen po byas/ kong ral gsum du mi sde khri lhag tsam 'tshogs pa'i nang du/ a dpal zhes pas zhu ba phul ba la/ drung rin po che pa gtsang chab 'di sngar chab nag gi ri 'khris pha gi la 'gro ba la/ da ni chu chen tshur 'gyur nas/ nged rgyal 'dzing pa'i zhing mang rab khyer/ grong gi rtsa bar sleb nas byung ba la/ grong pa spyis rdo mkhar chen po zhig nyos nas rag byas pa la'ang phan pa ma byung*/ yul spo ba la thug /da lags na gtsang chab chen po 'di sngar gyi shul pha gi la bsgyur ba zhu zhes pa'i zhu ba phul/ drung nas bden pa bdar zhing bkra shis brjod pas/ gtsang chen phyir log nas sngar mal la song bas/ mi thams cad shin tu dad par gyur/ de nas lkog 'phreng du byon te nyi shar mthon po la/ dben gnas btab nas bzhugs pa'i dus gcig gi tshe/ spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug zhal gzigs nas/ de'i bstod pa rkang pa brgya pa/ rjes su bsngags pa dang bcas pa zhes pa mdzad do// de nas rgya la rtse rdum/ chab dkar nag /rong klu nang du byon te skye 'gro dpag tu med pa bde 'gro'i lam la bkod par mdzad/ yang rgyal 'dzing du/ ra mig 'dzom pa bya bas rta'i brgya 'bul dang ston mo chen po byas/ de nas glang ma lung gi mdar/ drung gi zhal nas/ mdangs spyan ras gzigs dang mjal ba shin tu gsal bar rmis gsungs/ glang ma phur dben gnas zhig 'debs pa'i sa gzhi zhabs kyis bcags/

de nas sum mkhar/ gra bcos zing gsum/ phrags yul sogs mchi ma yul/ chab dkar nag dang*/ tsa ri bam ram dang*/ la rgyab dang*/ gcom phu lung rnams su byon/ gcom phu lung du dgun bzhugs mdzad pa'i sar/ zang zang nel ring pa'i rin po che dpon slob la sogs phyogs phyogs nas dge ba'i bshes gnyen mang po mjal du byung zhing*/ nel ring pas/ kha che gur gum gyis gtsos pa'i khyad ras kyi na bza' dang*/ gur gum zho brgya sogs 'bul nod dpag tu med pa mdzad de/ nā ro chos drug la sogs chos mang du gsan zhing*/ man ngag thams cad nyams khrid du bskyangs/ gnas 'dir chos gsung 'phro zhig la spyan nam mkha' la cher gyis gzigs nas/ 'o sgom chen pa mang po de zhal skyems mi mang po'i ja zhig skol grabs gyis gsungs pa la dgongs ja kha tsam la 'bri gung pa'i sgom chen bya ra kha pa bya bas dbu mdzad brgyad cu tsam zhig sleb/ de sogs rtag tu mngon par shes pa rgya chen pos lung ston par mdzad kyang phal gyis de ltar mi nges/ de nas bam ram la byon te/ drung pa dang*/ zang zang pa dang bcas pa'i dpon slob thams cad tsā ri'i gnas phyi nang thams cad du byon pa'i tshe/ phag mo dbu bcad ma/ tsaṇ+ḍi kā/ pad phug/ g.yu mtsho rnams su/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong dpag tu med pa zhal gzigs pa'i rnam 'gyur gyis dgyes tshor mdzad cing*/ sku 'khor phal pa rnams kyis kyang 'ja' dang 'od kyi phung po la sogs pa ngo mtshar ba'i ltas mang po mthun snang du grub pa byung*/ der drung gi zhal nas/ dpal rang byon gyi mchod rten gyi nye 'khor gyi phyogs mtshams su dur khrod kyi gling shin tu mang na yang gsar du zhal phye ba la/ bam chen dur khrod/ bdud rab tu bcom pa'i dur khrod chen po 'khor phran dang bcas pa/ bya gdong ma'i dur khrod 'khor phran dang bcas pa/ gzi byin mi bzad pa rab tu 'bar ba'i dur khrod kyi gling chen po 'khor phrad dang bcas pa/

dur khrod chen po 'bar ba'i phreng ba'i gling chen po 'khor phran dang bcas pa/ he ru ka rnam par bshad pa'i dur khrod kyi gling chen po 'khor phran dang bcas pa/ ma mo rab tu khros pa'i dur khrod kyi gling chen po 'khor phran dang bcas pa/ drag po rab tu khros pa'i sgra sgrogs kyi dur khrod chen po'i gling phran 'khor dang bcas pa rnams zhal phye ba yin gsungs/ de'i tshe na dkyil 'khor chen po rang rang gi lha'i grangs dang bcas pa rta babs sgo khyud phyi rol du dur khrod kyi rnam pa rnams sku 'khor phal pa rnams kyis kyang*/ rdo la rang byon du gsal bar mthong zhing*/ chos rje'i drung nas yi dam gyi dkyil 'khor dngos su gsal por zhal gzigs par snang na yang*/ dgyes pa'i rnam 'gyur tsam min pa zhal gyis mi bzhes/ der dpon slob kun glang gong la byon te/ rin po che nel ring pa dpon slob dbus gtsang la byon no// de nas yang zla ba bdun pa la/ chos rje'i drung nas gnas la byon dus rkyen ngan pa'i dbang gis/ gting zab phug tu sngar yod pa'i chu de skam 'dug pa la/ drung nas gtor ma dang bka' bsgo mdzad pas de ma thag tu chu de sngar bas bzang ba byung*/ de nas sgam po lha rje la byon te mchod rten che shos khang pa tsam/ chung ba khru tshad yan rdo la rang byon du byon pa tshan po che dang*/ gzhan yang rang byon mang po zhal gzigs pa'i tshe/ drung gi gsung nas/ rang byon 'di rnams shin tu dod po yang 'dug mod/ de dang mthun pa'i byin rlabs kyi ltas kyang 'dug /tsā ri gsar rnying gnyis rdo rje'i rwa g.yas g.yon yin cing*/ sgam po lha rje 'di rdo rje'i lte ba yin gsungs so// de nas nyang po la byon/ nyang po'i sa char/ si tu kun spangs pa dang*/ sgom pa sku mched kyis thog drangs pa'i mi chen/ dge 'dun/ skye bo'i tshogs dang bcas pa mang po la/ bzhed dgongs dang mthun pa'i zab cing rgya che ba'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor te rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che la phu dud du mdzad do/

de nas snye bo la gdan drangs/ tshur kong po ru byon/ kong yul bre sna ru/ rtse bla sgang zhes dgon pa btab par mdzad/ de dus su gzim khang gi mdun bla yel du khams pa'i chas byas pa'i rta pa mang po khrigs se gang 'dug pa/ chab nag pa dang*/ kar ma gyang ral ba sogs mang pos mthong 'dug /de dang mnyam du bud med gcig la bab ste/ nged khams stod kyi le yan chad kyi gzhi bdag yin/ chos rje ba gdan 'dren du 'ongs pa yin zer ba byung 'dug /der rab 'byams dbu ma'i gzhung lugs kyi snying po bsdus pa mu bzhi skye 'gog gi rigs pa mdor byas pa zhes pa'i bstan bcos mdzad/ rnam thos tshal nas rtogs ldan mtsho dkar ba dang*/ mi nyag seng ge rgyal mtshan gnyis rtse bla sgang du 'ongs pa nyang chus khyer ba la/ tshu ri nas drung gis gzigs nas/ phyag mkhar de chu la gtad cing shib shib gcig mdzad ma thag chu rlabs kyis tshur 'phen pa byung*/ de nas rgyar ma ru byon pa'i dus/ kong po'i chas byas pa'i rta pa mang po zhig /drung du chos zhu yin 'dug pa rtogs ldan mtsho dkar bas mthong*/ khong rnams song ba dang*/ de rnams kong po'i gzhi bdag 'dra yin pa lags sam zhus pas/ de yin khyod la rig pa dngas po byung 'dug gsungs/ de nas spo bo la byon pa'i lam ka bre mo gru so bya ba'i chu chen po la zom pa btsugs pa'i tshe/ sa chen po rab tu g.yos/ 'ja' 'od dpag par mi nus pa'i sgra skad la sogs pa byung ngo*// de'i tshe gnyug mar gnas pa'i gru pa des/ zam pa btsugs pas kho'i bza' la gnod kyis dogs nas/ phag tu gshe skur mang zhig byas yod par snang ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis/ kho rang gcig pu gru dang bcas pa rlung la sogs pa'i rkyen gzhan med par chus drag tu khyer ba'i tshe/ rba drag po'i klong la thug la khad pa na/ chos rje'i drung nas gzigs pa'i tshe/ rje btsun sgrol mas mi 'di chu'i 'jigs pa las bskyab tu gsol/

zhes gsol ba btab pa'i mod la/ sems ldan gyi sems can la mdza' bshes kyis skad btang ba bzhin du/ sems med kyi gru de slar log nas mi de bde bar chu'i ngogs su phyin par gyur to// de nas klo lam dkar nag bya ba'i lam 'phrang dam por/ mdzo rta khyu ded byas nas byon yang*/ po chag g.yangs gsum gang yang med par spo bor slebs pa ni/ chos rje'i grub rtags yang dag par 'dug na'ang*/ thams cad ngo mtshar du gyur pa'i gtam gleng ba'i skabs su/ chos rje'i zhal nas/ de ni gzhi bdag bzang ba'i drin yin gsungs par gda'/ lam de ni kong po la sogs pa'i rong mi rnams 'grim kyang*/ mi rkyang rnams kyang yid ma yengs par 'gro dgos pa'i sa yin/ 'phrang sgrol ma thag chos rje'i drung nas mgur ma 'di skad gsungs/ chos theg pa bla med gsang sngags la// thabs dam tshig sdom pa rten 'brel tshogs// gnad phyi nang gsang ba'i rnal 'byor tshul// don cung zad kyang 'da' bar dka' ba yi// lam 'phrang 'gag dam yang nye ba'i gsang*// yid ma yengs dran pa'i rgyun brten cing*// thabs rten 'brel gyi gnad la ma rmongs na// dus ring por mi thogs bde bar phyin// dpe ji ltar bgrod pa'i lam 'di bzhin// zhes gsungs/ de nas spo bo ye gong gi phu'i rma bskung lung zhes bya ba'i gnas chen ngo mtshar can gyi gnas sgo phyes/ de'i tshe yon bdag lkags lkugs na re/ sngar chos rje rang byung rdo rje'i zhal nas/ 'dir gnas khyad 'phags zhig yod pa'i sgo 'byed pa la nga rang sleb 'ong ba yin gsungs pa'i tshig de/ da don thog tu pheb 'dug ces gleng bar gda' de nas spo bo phu lung dgon pa'i rin po che dge 'dun gyi tshogs dang bcas pas gdan drangs te der byon/ dge 'dun skye bo'i tshogs dang bcas pa smin grol la 'god par mdzad do// rgyal 'bum gyis ldong ya lha khang 'bul ba sogs rgya ra'i dpon brgyud mi sde dang bcas pas zhabs tog phun sum tshogs pa byas/

de nas 'gu dngar ldem gsum/ tsha ba sgang stod/ mtha' bzhi rnams su byon te gdul bya dpag tu med pa smin grol gyi lam la 'god par mdzad do/ /dza ngom 'dus pa'i chab mdo zhes par mi gsum gru log nas chus khyer ba gcig gis/ chos rje rin po che thugs rjes zung byas nas 'o dod bos pas de ma thag tu chu dkyil gyi pha bong steng du chags te chu'i 'jigs pa las thar bar mdzad do// de nas chu bar/ lha steng*/ gdan sa chen po karma rnams su byon te/ rang rang gi sa nas zla lam tshun chad kyi/ bla ma/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen/ dge 'dun/ mi chen la sogs dad ldan gyi skye bo stong phrag mang po 'dus shing*/ lung ngag rig gsum gus pa'i sgo nas zang zing gi dngos po brjod kyis mi langs pa phul te/ so so'i khams rigs dang mthun pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po bskor bar mdzad/ khyad par du/ karma dgon du dge 'dun gyi tshogs dpag tu med pa 'tshogs shing*/ snod ldan rnams la nā ro chos drug la sogs pa'i zab chos rnams dang*/ gzhan yang gang la gang 'os kyi chos kyi 'khor lo dgun bzhugs de'i skabs su bskor nas/ khrid dang dgun bzhugs grol ba'i nyin por/ tshogs chos rgyas pa zhig gsungs pa'i rjes su/ sde bdag rnams kyis sde skyong lugs dang*/ rab tu byung ba rnams thos bsam sgom gsum mdzad tshul dang*/ skye bo phal pa rnams kyang gnas skabs bde skyid sgrub pa'i thabs dang*/ tha na long sprang yan chad la rang rang gi bya bzhag 'di dang 'di lta bu byed dgos pa yin/ ces khrims gnyis kyi sgo nas sde gnyis tshul bzhin du skyong ba'i thabs zhib la rgyas par gsungs te/ mthar/ da khyed dge 'dun rnam pa 'dir bzhugs pa dang phyogs su 'byon 'dod la sogs gang mos mdzod la mi lus thob pa don yod par mdzod/ re shig khams bzang po gyis/ nged dang yang myur por 'phrad par bgyid gsungs pa la/ dge 'dun rnams/

de ring 'di 'dra ba'i zhal ta dang khams bde'i mdzad tshul 'di lta bu sngar ni nam yang gnang ma myong zhes ngo mtshar zhing the tshom du gyur to// de nas 'dan stod ske rags brag rtsa'i rang byon sgrol ma'i drung du mjal te/ rim gyis khra sbom brag /kyi le gnas chen sogs su byon te/ so so'i bla ma/ dge bshes mi chen la sogs khri phrag mang po 'dus nas/ 'bul nod phun sum tshogs pa byas shing*/ chos dang zang zing gi sbyin pas tshim par mdzad do// khyad par du/ go 'gyo dpon chen 'od zer dpal gyis gdan drangs te/ tre stod du byon pa la/ mdzo rta/ gser dngul/ gos dar/ stag gzig/ snam ras/ ja sig la sogs brgya 'bul mang po byas shing*/ zab cing rgya che ba'i chos mang po zhus te/ mi phyed pa'i dad pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang*/ dge 'dun gyi sde srid la phan ci thogs byed par zhus so/ /de dus gong gi gser yig pa dang*/ 'jang yul ba'i gser yig tshan cher 'dzom mo/ /de nas rim gyis byon te/ ag 'dam/ sog pa mdo/ sog stod song du/ bra'o/ /spar thang*/ kha rong ba sogs dad ldan gyi skye bo dpag tu med pas 'bul ba bsnyen bkur rgya chen po bsgrubs shing*/ de rnams la zab cing rgya che ba'i chos kyi 'khor lo so so'i dbang po dang 'tshams par bskor/ der byung ba'i 'bul rta rnams/ mtshur phu'i gu'i shri la bskur te/ dbus gtsang gi dgon sde rnams su ja skol la btang*/

de nas nags shod du dge 'dun stong phrag kha yar tshogs pa la/ nā ro chos drug sogs zab cing rgya che ba'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ der byung ba'i 'bul rta rnams dus mchod pa chos dpal la bskur nas/ dbus gtsang gi dgon sde rnams su ja skol la btang*/ de nas 'bri khung spyan snga rin po che chos kyi rgyal po ba 'jal du byon te/ 'jam ne mtsho khar mjal phrad mdzad cing*/ nyang po rgyab mda'i bar du byon nas/ spyan snga chos kyi rgyal po ba dang*/ kun spang dge sbyong ba yab sras kyis gtso mdzad/ 'bri gung thel gyi bla ma dge 'dun pa dad pa dang skal par ldan pa/ nyang po lung pa'i sbyin bdag gi tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyis 'bul mchod rgya chen po mdzad cing*/ nā ro chos drug /sku gsum ngo sprod sogs man ngag zab chos/ khrid kyi bka' lung rnams dang*/ dpag bsam 'khri shing dang*/ skyes rabs brgya rtsa sogs byang chub sems dpa'i rnam thar ngo mtshar ba rnams kyi bshad pa sogs thugs bzhed dang mthun par/ gang la gang 'os kyi zab cing rgya che ba'i chos kyi dga' ston rgya chen po 'bul zhing gnang bar mdzad do// de nas kong po rta bar la byon/ yon bdag 'brug dar spun gyis rta'i brgya 'bul sogs skye bo thams cad kyis mchod sprin rgya chen po spros pa'i gdab lan du zab cing rgya che ba'i chos kyi char chen po phab ste thams cad la thar pa'i myu gu brtas par mdzad/ /mdor na bdag nyid chen po de'i sku mdun du mang dus 'bum phrag grangs las 'das shing*/ ji ltar nyung dus kyang lnga brgya tsam 'tshogs pa rnams la/ rab la zhi lhag zung 'brel gyi ting nge 'dzin 'phel bar mdzad/ 'bring rnams la gsung rab gzhung lugs rnam par dag pa'i tshig don khong du chud par mdzad/ tha ma rnams la'ang ma ṇi'i rgyun mi 'chad bgrangs su 'dzud cing*/ gang zag re re nas spro ba bskyed pa'i gtam mdzad pa/ zang zing gi dngos po rgya chen po yon du gnang ba/

mtshang nas 'bru ba yan chad mdzad cing ma ṇi dung phyur/ sa ya/ bye ba/ 'bum phrag /khri phrag brgya stong yan nyin re bzhin bgrangs pa'i dam bca' rang rang gi skal pa dang mthun par len par mdzad/ shin tu tha ma'i rab rnams la srog mi gcod pa'i sdom pa len/ 'bring rnams la tshes grangs dus tshod 'di dang 'di la srog mi gcod ces pa'i sdom pa len/ tha ma rnams la'ang nya la sogs pa'i sems can 'di dang 'di 'dra mi gsod ces pa'i sdom pa len pa dang*/ chu la rgyu ba dang ri la gnas pa'i srog chags phra rags rnams kyi rna lam du de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan khyad par can bsgrags pa la sogs pa sgo du ma nas thabs du mas/ mngon mtho dang nges legs la skye 'gro thams cad 'god par mdzad/ thugs kun brjod pa'i cho 'phrul gyis gdul bya skal ldan ga na yod mkhyen par mdzad de/ gsung rjes su bstan pa'i cho 'phrul gyis/ de rnams khams rigs dang mthun par chos bstan pa'i phyir du/ sku rdzu 'phrul gyis chos 'phrul gyis gdul bya skal ldan gar gnas kyi thad du gshegs pa'i/ sku 'khor du 'breng ba rnams dkar gsum gyi 'tsho bas bskyangs nas/ dpon slob rnams bzhugs pa'i shul du/ bsad sha'i rus bu la sogs mthong na bka' bkyon zhing*/ chang zhes pa'i myos byed de'i dri tsam yang*/ sgar khong der bro ba med pa sogs kun spyod rnam par dag pa la 'god par mdzad do// thog ma nas sangs rgyas sprul pa'i sku chen po yin kyang*/ gdul bya rnams la spyod pa rnam par dag pa bstan pa'i ched du/ 'gro 'chag nyal 'dug thams cad du phyag rgya chen po la 'jog pa'i ngang nas nam langs nas nyi dros kyi bar ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs/ de nas nyi ma phyed kyi bar la chos gsungs/ de nas sku gsung thugs kyi rten pa phyag brgya rtsa mdzad cing bshags pa mdzad/ skor ba brgya rtsa mdzad cing ma ṇi bsgrang ba dang*/ gtor ma sogs srod kyi bar du mdzad/

skabs skabs su bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab la gzigs rtog mdzad/ srod nas nam langs kyi bar du/ rmi lam sprul sgyur gyi sgo nas sems can gyi don mdzad de/ 'di lta bu'i khor yug la bar stongs cung zad kyang mi 'jog /shi dge gson gnas dbang bskur bdun tshig sogs gang byed kyang sha khrag gi ston mo mi bya/ sha'i ston mo gang yin pa de ni dge bar btags kyang sdig las 'ba' zhig yin/ za mkhan 'dren mkhan gsod mkhan gsum ka sdig pa mnyam pas dmyal bar 'gro gsungs nas/ yon mchod kun la dam bsgrag che bar mdzad/ bstod smad sogs la byams sdang gi rnam dbye mi mdzad kyang*/ ngan spyod sdig las can sogs la thugs brnag pa yun ring ba lta bu dang*/ mkhas btsun bzang gsum sogs kyi yon tan cung zad yod pa yang shin tu mnyes pa'i tshul gyis 'dor len yang mdzad/ yo byad ji tsam phul yang mnyes pa'i rnam 'gyur mi mdzad cing*/ nyams rtogs sam go ba bzang po tshig re phul na'ang mnyes pa'i rnam 'gyur chen po mdzad/ yo byad la chags pa med kyang phra mo tsam yang chud zos su ma song bar mchod sbyin sogs rnam dkar gyi rgyur dengs par mdzad/ chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid kyi lta ba thugs thag chod bar zhal gyis bzhes shing*/ gom pa gang bzhud na'ang g.yas skor gyi phyogs nas bzhud pa sogs rgyu 'bras phra zhing phra ba la'ang rten 'brel sarga ma log par mdzad/ chos kyi gsung gleng min pa gsung mi 'byon/ bdag gzhan 'khor ba'i mtsho las bsgral zhing gtan bde'i go 'phang thob pa'i thabs khyad par can la/ su dang mi mnyam pa'i brtson pa chen po mdzad pa sogs mkhas btsun bzang po'i rnam thar blo'i ra ba las brgal bar bzhugs/ de lta bu'i bdag nyid chen po de skye 'chi la dbang thob pa yin na'ang rtag 'dzin can rnams chos la bskul ba sogs kyi dus mkhyen nas/ sngar dgung lo dgu bzhes pa'i dus su bsnyun gzhi thu mo zhig byung ba'i tshe/

gzhan rnams kyis sems las byas pa na/ nged bud med la sogs pa mi gtsang pa yod sa 'dir da lan mi 'chi/ da gzod sa gtsang sa zhig tu 'chi ba yin gsungs/ sgom sde'i sa cha rdza a ban gangs kyi me long gi mdun du bsnyun pa'i dus zhig sku 'khor rnams kyis sems las byas pa na/ nged da lan mi 'chi khyed rang rnams sems khral mi dgos/ da bzod sha rkyang mang po 'phyo pa'i sa gtsang sa zhig tu khams bzang ngan byung srid na/ de dus dpe cha rnams ma 'thor ba byed dgos pa yin ang gsungs pa dang*/ kar mar zhal ta gnang ba sogs dang mthun par tha ma'i mdzad pa ston par bzhed nas brag gsum zho khar phyag dpe glegs shing med pa rnams glegs shing dang sku rags brje ba dang gsar pa rnams gang dgos mdzad de/ shing sgam mang po'ang bzos te de rnams su bzhugs su 'jug pa sogs sngar bas do dam che bar mdzad cing de nyid du bzhugs su bcug/ de nas brag gsum phu'i bca' gung bam 'dor chos gsungs pa'i skabs zhig tu/ rgya yul du yin na/ ti shri dang*/ bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po rnams 'das nas/ spur de a ga ru dang tsan+dan gyi mes bzhu ba yin par 'dug /chos rje gong ma bde bar gshegs dus gan nas tsan+dan a ga ru shing rta gang bas spur bzhus pa yin par 'dug /rang re bod 'dir tsan+dan a ga ru'i tshab shug pa 'di yin/ byang du me shing dkon po byung dogs yod pas shug pa shog la khol gsungs pa dang*/ lar gyi bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi spur de gtsang sar sbyangs pa yin ces dang*/ tsan+dan a ga ru la sogs rnams/ nad pa la sogs pa su la glo bur du mkho mi shes pas thams cad khol cig ces gsungs pa bzhin du byas nas nags shod du pheb pa'i dus/ sku 'khor gcig gi lag pa chag 'dug zhus pas/ de kun rngam chung*/ gyod chen po da gzod byung dogs yod gsungs/ yang chos ra zhig tu snyigs dus kyi sems can dmu rgod rnams la legs pa'i lam bstan kyang 'jug par dka' bar gda'/

nges 'byung dang skyo ba skyed pa'i thabs 'dra byas na phan pa yang srid/ ces sogs mang du gsungs pa'i tshe/ chos ra der ras dkar ba bya ba zhig yod pa des phyag phul te/ drung rin po che/ de 'dra mi gsung bar dbu lo dkar yengs kyi ma song bar du 'gro ba'i don la bzhugs pa thugs la 'dogs par zhu zhes zhus par/ chos nyan gzhan rnams kyis smyon pa 'di zhes bzhad gad byas par snang*/ karmar 'gro rgyu'i bya bral ba rnams la zhal ta gsung shog zhib la rgyas par bskur nas/ yang yang nged kyis khad byed pa dka' nyen yod pas/ nged kyis 'di rnams la lab pa'i dpang po khyod kyis gyis gsungs nas/ rgyal ba dpal dpang por bzhag nas 'di rnams yid la zhog gsungs/ de nas shag gi stod du deng sang karma sku 'bum zer ba der chags pheb nas phag lo zla ba bdun pa'i tshe gsum la dad ldan gyi gdul bya dpag tu med pa 'dus pa la chos gsung ba'i chos dung bus pa na/ drung gi zhal nas/ chos dung gi skad kyang 'bring tsam 'dug /khar sang rten zhal bstan pa'i rten 'brel yang shin tu ngan gsungs/ de nas chos khri khar byon pa'i mdun gyi ri logs la 'ja' 'od kyi phung po shin tu gsal ba zhig 'dug pa kun gyis mthong ba na/ drung gi zhal nas/ 'ja' legs 'on kyang dus min gyi 'ja' legs pa 'di 'dra de/ byang chub sems dpa' gshegs bzhud byed pa'i ltas su yod par snang*/ sngar byang chub sems dpa' chos rgyal 'phags pa de gshegs pa'i dus su blo bur 'ja' 'di lta bu byung yod par snang gsungs/ de'i zhag gsum gyi gong du rgyun du bcibs pa'i chibs pa rkyang dkar de rtswa za ru ma nyan pas/ rta rdzis na ba yin snyam nas sman dpyad byas pa na/ drung gi zhal nas/ rta sdug pas bdag po dang bral bas ma dga' ba yin/ bcos mi dgos pa yin gsungs/ tshes gsum gyi nub mo nas cung zad bsnyun pa'i tshul bstan te/ tshes bco lnga'i srod la bab pa'i tshe spyan nam mkhar gzigs shing sku gsung thugs kyi rten la bskor ba lnga bcu rtsa bdun mdzad de/

zhal nas/ byams chen 'jam pa'i dbyangs dang kun tu bzang*// spyan ras gzigs dbang mthu chen thob la sogs// ces sogs mang du gsungs/ de nas skya rengs shar gyi bar mnyam bzhag la bzhugs/ skya rengs phyi ma shar ba'i tshe/ sprul sku 'di nyid kyi bkod pa bsdus te/ 'od gsal mtha' dbus med pa chos kyi dbyings kyi ngang du snyoms par zhugs par gyur to// de'i tshe sgra dang 'od dang sa g.yo ba sogs ltas cho 'phrul bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung zhing*/ sku 'khor phal pa 'ga' zhig gis ni bud med sngon mo dpag tu med pa byung nas nub phyogs su gdan drangs pa mthong*/ 'ga' zhig gis ni rta pa khri phrag mang po sgar nang du byung ba mthong nas gar song cha med zhes grags la/ 'ga' zhig gis ni 'ja' 'od kyi gong bu chen po zhig steng gi nam mkhar 'phags pa mthong gda'/ de ltar mthong snang mi 'dra ba du ma byung zhing*/ sku yal ba ni/ bzhi lnga zhig min pas ma tshor nas the tshom gyis gleng gzhi du ma byas skad/ de'i nyin mo nyi ma'ang gzas zin pa bzhin du 'od mi gsal bar gyur la/ de dang mnyam du/ kong po'i rgyab na yod pa'i klo mang pos/ chos rje'i drung nas nam mkha' la skar ma bdun gyi steng du bzhugs te/ byang phyogs nas lho phyogs su byon pa mthun snang du grub par mthong nas/ kong por tshong la 'ongs pa'i klo rnams na re khyed kyi rang byung rdo rje de/ khar nyin nyi ma mi gsal ba'i tho rangs kha/ nged kyi steng nas lho phyogs su skar ma bdun gyi steng na bsdad nas song*/ da bod na med zer dus tshod bsgrigs pas 'das tshod dang gcig rang du gda'/ de nas nyi shu gcig gi nyin spur zhugs la bzhen pa'i tshe/ rgyang ring phyogs 'ga' zhig tu ni skar mda' lhung zhing*/ ri klung thams cad mun pas byug pa ltar snang la/ phyogs 'ga' zhig tu ni sgra drag po mi bzad par grags la/ 'ga' zhig tu ni gzhan na med pa'i nyi ma 'od dkor nang gi mar me lta bur snang*/

'das pa'i nyin zhag la rtse zhing yod pa'i bya rnams skad mi sgrogs pa byung*/ gdung bzhu pa'i steng du ni 'ja' tshon sna lnga'i gur phub cing*/ karma pa rgyal ba dpal gyis gsol ba btab cing phyag 'tshal ba'i skabs su/ 'ja' 'od kyi phung po'i nang du mdo li 'dra ba zhig gi steng na/ chos rje'i drung nas bzhugs te mdo li 'dra ba de'i 'og dang phyogs rnams su ngo shes rgyu med pa'i sems can sna tshogs pas bskor nas/ nub byang nas lho phyogs la gshegs pa mthong ste/ rtogs ldan 'tsho chung la bstan pas/ de'i bar la mi gsal bar gyur nas gnyis kas 'ja' las ma mthong*/ de nas sku gdung gdan drangs te/ gdan sa dpal ldan mtshur phur byon pa'i lam ka thams cad du skye bo kun gyi mthun snang du grub par/ gdung gang du gdan drangs pa'i sa phyogs dpag tshad gsum tsam tshun chad/ steng nas me tog gi char bab cing phyogs thams cad rab tu gsal ba'i kha dog sna lnga pa can gyi 'ja' 'od kyi phung po chen po dkrigs pa'i dbus nas 'od zer sna tshogs pa 'phro ba mthong*/ phag lo zla ba brgyad pa'i tshes brgyad kyi nyin par/ dpal mtshur phur gdung gi drung nas phebs/ tshes bcu'i nyin mtshur phur bzhugs pa'i bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen dge 'dun/ skye bo'i tshogs dang bcas pa dang*/ gzhan yang phyogs phyogs nas bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen dge 'dun/ skye bo'i tshogs dang bcas pa khri phrag lhag la gser zho re non po shes pa'i 'gyed dang bsnyen bkur drangs pa'i tshe/ nam mkha' g.ya' yongs su dag pa la 'ja' dang 'od dang me tog gi char pa la sogs pa ngo mtshar ba'i ltas bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung bas/ skye bo rnams dad cing smin grol la bkod de rgyal ba'i thugs dgongs rdzogs pa mdzad do// zla ba de'i tshes bco brgyad kyi nyin/ mtshur nang gi bar snang thams cad 'ja' dang 'od kyis dkrigs shing*/ rnam par du mdzo rta'i rdzi bo rnams yod pa'i nang nas/

pad ma skyabs zhes pa'i mdo smad pa gcig gis/ 'ja' 'od kyi dkyil du chos rje rin po che'i drung nas/ dbu zhwa nag po dang phya ru dur kha mnab pas g.yag lta bu sngon po chen po zhig la bcibs pa/ phyag tu lug gi rnam pa dkar po zhig bsnams nas mdun na yar la rked pa yan chad mi'i rnam pa man chad sbyin gyi nang du nub pa rnams la byin rlabs bshar pa'i rnam pa lta bu/ de yang chibs pa de'i khog stod smad gsal por mthong*/ sug po man chad sprin gyi nang du nub pa zhig nub ngos nas shar phyogs su byon pa gsal por mthong nas gzhan la bstan pas/ mtshur nang pa don rgyal pa bya bas sku sked yan mthong*/ gling gi mi rigs glen pa bya ba zhig gis dbu zhwa de mthong*/ gzhan rnams kyis 'ja' tshon las ma mthong*/ skabs der kong po tam phyogs rgyal chung bya bas byis pa'i dus su ra 'tshos nas/ chos rje'i drung nas bzhugs pa'i nam mkha' dang sa gzhi thams cad/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gzugs kyis bar mtshams med par gang ba mthong nas/ dad pa skyes te rab tu byung nas dge sbyor byed pa zhig yod pa des/ drung nas sngar gyi chibs pa dkar po zhig yod pa de la chibs/ 'khor gnyis rkang thang gi rnam par byas pa'i/ dpon slob gsum nam mkha' la byon song ba mngon sum du mthong bas/ kye ma 'gro ba'i mgon po khyed gar gshegs pa der kho bo yang thugs rjes 'dzin par zhu zhes nyin zhag mang por 'o dod bos shing mchi mas brnangs lus sa la brdab par byas/ de la skye bo kun gyis sgom chen 'di smyo 'dug zer/

gzhan yang rtse bla sgang gi gzim khang du/ dpon slob bdun mdzad de byon pa mang pos mngon sum du mthong ste/ bltar phyin pas sngar gyi sgo'i rgya ma zhig par snang ba dang*/ lha sar jo bo'i drung du dpon slob bdun mdzad de dngul sder gser gyis bkang ba 'thor zhing*/ bskor ba mdzad nas nam mkha' la 'ja' tshon du yal ba dang*/ mtshur phur nam mkha' la byon nas kho bo dga' ldan du 'gro skye ba myur du 'ongs gsungs nas/ shar gyi nam mkha' la gshegs te rnam par mdor 'ja' 'od du yal ba mang pos mthong*/ mon yul bya bral ba byung ba na re/ chos rje dpon slob brgyad cu tsam byon mon gyi rgyal po rab tu byung*/ nā ro ni gu'i chos drug gsung zhing yod zer/ sa le'i bar du a tsa ra dang tshong pa lam nor ba la mdun du byon nas/ rin po ches mang po gnang lam bstan nas nged 'dir mi 'dug gsungs nas seng ge la chibs te gshegs pa mthong*/ slob dpon chen po sogs sgar pa rnams dbus na phebs tshe steng gi nam mkhar bzhugs pa sgar pa byin gyis mthong*/ zho khar pheb la khad pa na chibs mgo nag gi steng na bzhugs pa thams cad kyis yud tsam mthong*/ rtse lha sgang du phebs tshe dpon slob bco lnga tsam byon nas gru khyer shog gsungs ba mthong*/ gru khyer tshe steng gi nam mkha' la byon nas gzim khang du byon pa mthong*/ zla ba bzhi pa'i tshes bcu bzhi la 'ja' 'od kyi steng na bzhugs pa kong po'i khrom phal cher gyis mthong*/ sgom chen pa 'gas rgya la'i seng 'dam du mjal te/ chos thob nas 'ja' tshon du yal bar snang*/ khyad par du myang 'dam gyi stod du bla ma zhig phyi dro nyi ma la 'dug pa na drung nyid seng ge la chibs 'ja' 'od kyi dbus su mu tig gi khang par bzhugs pa zhig nam mkha' la byon te/ myang 'dam du bzhud par mthong bas chos rje karma pa de seng ge la chibs 'ja' 'od dang*/ khang bzang du bzhugs pa cig byon te thal sku khams ma bzang ba yin nam zer nas/

dad pas ngus/ kun gyis mthong bar yang myang 'dam gyi sar 'ja' tshon 'khrigs/ me tog gi char babs pa nyin re bzhin rtag tu byung zhing dri bzang gis yul thams cad khyab pa byung*/ rje de'i nang rten du thub pa'i dbang po'i gser sku rgyab mtho bco brgyad yod pa khra rgyab dang bcas pa dang*/ sku 'dra gser sku rgyab mtho brgyad pa dang*/ dngul bre brgyad cu las bzhengs shing srog shing a ga ru las byas pa'i dngul gdung chen mo gcig rnams byon legs shing mtshar du chags par bzhengs nas/ gdan sa dpal gyi mtshur phur rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga mdzad pa'i tshe/ 'ja' dang 'od dang me tog gi char chen po bab/ khyad par dngul 'bum bzhengs pa'i tshe/ g.yang kha steng pa'i gang zag rnams dang mgar ba tshan pa gnyis dang*/ zhal ta mdzad mi rnams dang*/ thams cad kyi mthun snang du grub par/ nyin mo mis dngul mgar byas pa'i shul du/ mtshan mo mgar ba mang pos mgar byed pa'i skad thos te/ rang rang so so'i bsams pa la/ khong rang rnams 'dod pa'i dbang gis mtshan mo gzhan gyi mgar byed par 'dug snyam pa byung shing*/ de'i skabs su dngul mgar ba rnams/ sngar bas shes pa gsal ba dang*/ lag bde ba stobs rnams nyis 'gyur gyis che ba byung ste thams cad ngo mtshar bar gyur to// de ltar chos rje rol pa'i rdo rje'i rnam par thar pa 'di ni karma dkon mchog gzhon nus mdzad pa'i rnam thar nyid rgyas shing rtsa ba lta bur 'dug pas gzhir bzhag /bla ma lha steng bas bkod pa'i dgung lo bdun phan gyi rnam thar nas kyang kha bkang*/ rje mkha' spyod pa'i gsung dang*/ gtsug lag phreng ba'i chos 'byung*/ tshal pa'i deb ther sogs nas kyang bsnon du 'os pa rnams bsdus te sbyar ba yin zhing*/ spyir 'phags chen rnams kyi rnam par thar pa tshad med par ma zad/ rje thugs shin tu sgam pas zab cing rgya che ba'i tshul rnams shin tu sbed par mdzad pa las/ tshur mthong gi snang ngor bstan pa'i mdzad pa phyogs tsam zhig ste/

dkon gzhon gyis rnam thar brtsams pa'i rgyu mtshan du/ bla ma'i rnam thar rtsom pa la phyi nang gsang gsum gyi kun spyod rnams shes dgos pas/ bla ma rang nyid dam rang las rtogs pa mtho ba'am mnyam pa cig dgos pa yin/ de'i phyir bdag 'dras ga la shes/ 'dir zhal gzigs 'dra thar thor bris pa ni/ gu'i gung pa'i drung nas chos rje rin po che'i sku dang grib ma'i tshul du bzhugs pa'i gsung sgros dang*/ drung nyid kyi gsung 'bum du gsal bar snang na'ang rags rim zhig yin/ de yang khong pa la khyed sku dang grib ma bzhin du bzhugs pas rnam thar zhib mo zhig gsung na/ kho bos yi ge la 'debs par zhu zhes pa la/ gu'i gung pa'i zhal nas/ nged kyis chos kyi rje'i drung du yi dam gyi zhal gzigs tshul sogs ngo mtshar che che 'dra yi ge la bkod na/ mi mang po mos gus skye ba la phan par gda' zhus pas/ drung gi zhal nas/ de 'dra bri yis ga la lang*/ gnyid thun re'i nang du'ang yi dam chos skyong gi snang ba dang*/ chos kyi tshig don zab la rgya che ba mang po 'ong bar snang zhing*/ nyin par yang ngo mtshar can gyi rnam 'gyur 'dra mang po 'ong gin gda' mod/ de 'dra bshad na dad pa mi skye ba'i steng du zog po brdzun ma zer nas/ gshe skur sna tshogs byed du 'ongs/ da lta'i sems can ma rungs pa rnams kyis/ yon tan bstan kyang mi mthong bar skyon sbas kyang mthong ba de ka mang bar gda'/ lab lob ma byed/ nged kyi rnam thar kun gyis mthong ba'i kun spyod ma ṇi bskul ba dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung bsgrags pa sems can la gnod 'tshe spong du 'jug pa la sogs sems can dang bstan pa la phan ci thogs byed pa 'di yin mod gsungs/ de ltar gsung na'ang yi dam zhal gzigs 'dra nga rang la gsungs pa rnams yi ge la bri dgos snyams nas/ re shig gi tshe bri ba'i grabs byas pa na drung nas gzigs te/ snag tsha pho shog gu rnams bkral nas khyod kyis nga zog por ma gtong*/

sems can bsod nams dman pa 'ga' zhig dmyal bar 'gro ba'i dmigs rkyen ma byed ces gsungs nas bka' drag tu bkyon/ yang sngar bla ma ri bo sgang pas rnam thar gyi shog dril mang po byas 'dug pa gsan te/ de bzang khyer shog gsungs nas phul ba dang*/ mer bsregs bka' bkyon da phyin chad 'di 'dra ma rtsoms gsungs/ de'i phyir sngar yang su la ma bshad/ da rung yang rnam thar bri ba mi drag las che gsungs nas ma gnang ba yin/ ces gu'i gung pa rin chen dpal bas gsungs/ /zhes dang*/ yang com phu lung du kho bos drung nas kyi rnam thar ngo mtshar ba ya zung gsung ba thugs la 'dogs par zhu/ yi ge la bkod na dad ldan gyi dad pa 'phel ba'i dmigs rkyen du 'gyur ba lags zhus pas/ 'di na'ang mi 'ga' zhig gis/ nged sprang ba phyin nas yon bdag dang 'phrad tshul dang*/ mdzo rta ded nas la lung mang por phyin lugs rnams yi ger 'god pa'i grabs 'dug pa nged kyis bzlog /yi dam mkha' 'gro dang zhal mjal tshul dang*/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma'i gsang tshig rnams yi ger bris nas khrom chen po la sgrog nyan nam mi nyan/ khyed gsang sngags la mkhas pa chen po yin pas shes mod/ gzhan chos kyi 'bel gtam 'dra mdzod gsungs nas mi gnang bar gda' lags/ de lta na khyod rnam thar rtsom pa ci yin zhe na/ byang chub sems zol med pa'i skyes bu chen po la ma dad pa'i sems skyes na/ khams gsum gyi sems can gyi mig phyung ba las kyang sdig pa che zhing de 'dra la dad pa dang gus pa'i sems skyes na/ stong gsum gyi sems can mig med pa la mig byin pa bas bsod nams che zhes mdo sde las gsungs pa'i phan yon dang nyes dmigs la bsams nas/ sdom pa nyi shu par/ sems dge ba la nyes pa med/ /ces pa'i tshul du mthong zhing thos pa'i rnam thar cung zad bris pa yin no/ /ji bzhin bdag 'dras ga la shes/ /cha tsam 'di rnams ni/ dmus long gis glang po che'i tshad byed pa'am/

rus sbal long bas rgya mtsho'i tshad byed pa dang 'dra'o/ /bris pa 'di gong 'og rnams la nged rang gis rang bzo byas pa ni gcig kyang med pas yid ches pa'i gnas su yod do/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro// ༈¿¿rje 'di'i bu slob kyang brgyud 'dzin gyi gtso bo rtogs ldan mkha' spyod dbang po/ slob dpon gu'i gung pa rin chen dpal/ mkhan chen mgo blon pa blo gros rgyal mtshan/ mtshur phu rin po che kun spangs pa/ karma pa dkon gzhon/ 'brang bu rin po che/ rtogs ldan mtsho dkar ba/ ras dkar ba ri khrod sangs rgyas/ yang nge sgom seng*/ ri khrod sgom grags/ do po pa sangs rin/ 'ga' tsha sgom chen/ skra pa chos skyong dpal/ phyugs mo byams sar pa/ si tu drung chen pa/ nang pa thugs rje rgyal mtshan/ yol pa ye shes dpal/ zhwa dmar pa/ bla ma brag gong ba sogs dang*/ chos kyis 'brel ba'i skyes chen 'bri gung chos kyi rgyal po/ kun spangs ye shes rgyal mtshan/ 'bri gung lo tsa ba/ zang zang ne ring pa/ 'be byams chos pa/ ka bzhi 'dzin pa rin chen dpal/ ma se ston pa/ dpal de'u ye shes rdo rje/ lho rin po che grags yon pa/ spang mkhan chen 'od zer bla ma/ shing mgo dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ rgya ston chos kyi bzang po/ ka bzhi pa grags rdor/ tho ka ba chos 'od/ rje rin po che blo bzang grags pa sogs so// ༈¿¿de las gu'i gung pa rin chen dpal ni/ 'khrungs yul stod lung gi ka ba gdong pa/ rje rang byung rdo rje stod lung mda'i ne thang la sgar bzhugs tshe/ byis pa du ma lci ba 'thu zhing rtse ba'i tshe/ gzim khyi zhig shor bas gzhan thams cad gar 'gro ma rnyed/ byis pa gcig gis me shing snod rtse po kha sbub pa'i 'og tu zhugs te thag pa nang nas bzung bas khyis bskor yang thabs ma rnyed pas log thams cad ya mtshan du byas/ der drung gis pha ma la bka' lung gnang bas phul te rab tu byung nas/ 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed kyi rig sngags grub/

lugs gnyis kyi mkhyen pa sus kyang gzhal du med/ drung na rim gsum gyi gu'i gung pa mdzad de phyag rjes mtha' yas rgya hor gyi rgyal bu mi chen/ bod kyi dpon chen khri dpon si tu sogs las ka can thams cad kyis rtsod med du bkur/ mtshan slob dpon chen po las gzhan mi 'bod/ karma pa'i bstan pa la slob mas bya ba byas pa 'di che ba yin/ lo tshigs nges pa can ma rnyed kyang rje rang byung ba'i sku tshe'i sgang smad nas mjal te/ phyis rje de bzhin gshegs pa dang mjal zhing gsung chos kyang mang du phul bar snang ngo*// ༈¿¿mkhan chen mgo blon pa ni/ mdo khams kyi stag rong tsha'i nang tshan mgo blon/ rje 'di'i drung du pheb nas sku mdun du 'bral med bsten zhing chags phyi mdzad/ rje de bzhin gshegs pa'i spyan snga pa dang*/ don ldan zhabs kyang sku bskyed bsrings nas/ rje na rim gsum gyi drung du bsnyen cing spyan ras gzigs kyi snying po bskul ba dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi mtshan bsgrags pa sogs sems can la phan nges pa'i 'gro don yang mang du mdzad/ rgya hor gyi rgyal po rnams kyis kyang bkur zhing ta'i go shrī'i las ka gnad/ sgar pa kong por pheb pa'i lam dbyi gshis su glang lo zla ba bcu gcig pa'i tshes bcu bzhi la gshegs/ ring bsrel dang 'ja' 'od sogs ngo mtshur gyi ltas du ma byung ngo*// ༈¿¿mtshur phu rin po che kun spangs pa kun dga' blo gros ni/ grub thob chen po'i dbon rigs/ dbon po dka' thub kyi sras che ba yin te/ chos blo'i rjes su mtshar phu'i gdan sa lo shas tsam bzung ngo*// ༈¿¿mkhas pa chen po karma pa dkon gzhon ni/ rje rang byung ba'i zhabs la thug tsam dang*/ gtso bor rje rol pa'i rdo rje'i slob ma yin/ gsang phur mtshan nyid sbyangs/ bod kyi ston pa cig la mkhas par grags/ re mda' ba gzhon nu blo gros/ lo chen skyabs mchog bzang po/ btsong kha pa blo bzang grags pa rnams 'dus nas/

gnam tse ldeng gi chos 'khor du grags pa mdzad tshe chos 'khor gyi gral dpon mdzad/ mkhan chen g.yag pa dang*/ kun mkhyen rong pos kyang byams chos phyi ma rnams gtso bor 'di las gsan/ spyir mtshur phu'i karma de mgor bzhugs pa yin no// ༈¿¿rtogs ldan byang rgyal ba ni/ khams su sbom brag gi sgrub gnas su lo nyi shu rtsa lngar bsgrub pa mdzad/ phyis tsā ri mtsho dkar du bsgrub pa mdzad pas mtsho dkar ba grags/ chos rje'i drung nas gdams ngag rnams rdzogs par gnang nas rtogs ldan khrid dgar grags/ bsam yas kyi zur du bzhugs nas phyis gshegs pa'i tshe/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku mang du byon no// ༈¿¿'be byams chos pa ni/ mdo khams 'be ru 'khrungs/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan dang mjal/ mtshan dngos byang chub rgyal mtshan yin/ bo dor er mdo sngags kyi 'chad nyan mdzad nas mkhas par gyur/ byams chos gtso bor mdzad pas byams chos par grags/ rje rol pa'i rdo rje la phyag chen chos drug sogs chos khrid mang po zhus pas rtogs pa mngon du gyur/ spu ru brag tu rtse gcig bsgrub pa kho na mdzad// ༈¿¿rma se ston pa ni/ mi nyag pa yin/ 'bo gangs dkar gyi nye logs su rma se dgon btab/ 'chad nyan shin tu dar ba byung zhing*/ da lta'ang dgon de yod/ ༈¿¿rgya ston chos kyi bzang po ni/ rgya ston dkon mchog seng ge la rab tu byung*/ mtshan chos kyi bzang por btags/ gsang phur byon phar tshad kyi gsan pa'ang mdzad/ dgung lo nyer gcig par chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan drung du bsnyen par rdzogs/ 'be byams chos pa las dbang khrid mang po zhus/ rje rol pa'i rdo rje'i drung nas phyag chen dang chos drug gi smin khrid zhus nas don dam pa dang 'phrad/ mtshur phur ye gzhon pa la bka' brgyud kyi chos skor mang du zhus// ༈¿¿rje btsong kha pa blo bzang grags pa ni/ gangs ljongs 'dir nyi zla ltar grags pas rgyas par spro ma dgos shing*/

ji skad du/ lo gsum lon tshe grub chen karma pa// rol ba'i rdo rjes yongs rdzogs dge bsnyen mdzad// kun dga' snying po zhes su mtshan yang gsol// thub bstan sgo ru zhugs pa'i btsong kha pa// blo bzang grags pa'i zhabs la// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rje rol pa'i rdo rjes yongs rdzogs dge bsnyen mdzad/ /mtshan kun dga' snying por gsol/ thugs rgyud byin gyis brlabs nas/ dbus gtsang du pheb na ston pa gnyis pa lta bu'i phrin las 'byung zhes bka' stsal pa bzhin 'di byung ba yin cing*/ rgyal tshab dang mkhas grub rje sogs mkhas btsun gyi slob ma du ma dang lhag pa'i lhas lung bstan cing rje rin po che'i nges don gyi bstan pa gtad pa'i thugs sras dam pa rgyal mtshan bzang po sogs mkhas grub kyi slob ma gnam gyi skar tshogs tsam byon pa yin//
